The UNC and the families agreed to accept the bodies after receiving assurances of justice at a tripartite meeting involving the Union government, the Manipur government and Naga organisations in Guwahati on September 26, and after the completion of a safer alternative road for the people of Konsakhul village. The families received the bodies on Monday and transported them to their home village of Konsakhul in the Kuki-dominated Kangpokpi district for the final rites. People from various communities gathered for the funeral. Speaking at the funeral, United Naga Council (UNC) president N.G. Lorho said May 13, 2026, would remain the darkest day in Manipur’s history. “On that day, six Naga men were killed, mutilated, and dismembered at Leilon Vaiphei village by KNF-P (Kuki National Front-Presidential), Kuki militants, and Leilon villagers. Their bodies were treated in a manner that brings shame to the State of Manipur and to India before the whole world,” he said. He also noted that the funeral underscored the unity of the Nagas and other indigenous communities of Manipur. “Our land is being invaded and ravaged. Our people are being killed, displaced, and terrorised. If this incursion is not stopped, the very existence, identity, and future of the indigenous people of Manipur will be at stake,” Mr. Lorho said. The UNC, Manipur’s apex Naga organisation, urged the Centre to immediately end the “policy of appeasement and protection of militant groups” carrying out attacks and killings, and to fulfill its constitutional and moral responsibility to protect the lives, land, and identity of indigenous people.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The killing of three Thadou church leaders in an ambush in Kangpokpi district on May 13 prompted a series of abductions. The Thadous are divided over their Kuki identity.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Six Liangmai Naga civilians laid to rest in Manipur 187 days after abduction, killing

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 06:42:45 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: United Naga Council president N.G. Lorho said May 13, 2026, would remain the darkest day in Manipur’s history

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The bodies of six Liangmai Naga civilians were laid to rest in Manipur’s Kangpokpi district on Monday (November 16, 2026), 187 days after they were abducted and subsequently killed almost a month later. The family of the deceased and Naga organisations had refused to claim the bodies — kept at the mortuary of the Jawaharlal Nehru Institute of Medical Sciences in Imphal since June 10 — until their demands were met. One of the main demands of the Naga civil bodies was the abrogation of the 2008 Suspension of Operations agreements with 25 Kuki-Zomi armed groups. The UNC and the families agreed to accept the bodies after receiving assurances of justice at a tripartite meeting involving the Union government, the Manipur government and Naga organisations in Guwahati on September 26, and after the completion of a safer alternative road for the people of Konsakhul village. The families received the bodies on Monday and transported them to their home village of Konsakhul in the Kuki-dominated Kangpokpi district for the final rites. People from various communities gathered for the funeral. Speaking at the funeral, United Naga Council (UNC) president N.G. Lorho said May 13, 2026, would remain the darkest day in Manipur’s history. “On that day, six Naga men were killed, mutilated, and dismembered at Leilon Vaiphei village by KNF-P (Kuki National Front-Presidential), Kuki militants, and Leilon villagers. Their bodies were treated in a manner that brings shame to the State of Manipur and to India before the whole world,” he said. He also noted that the funeral underscored the unity of the Nagas and other indigenous communities of Manipur. “Our land is being invaded and ravaged. Our people are being killed, displaced, and terrorised. If this incursion is not stopped, the very existence, identity, and future of the indigenous people of Manipur will be at stake,” Mr. Lorho said. The UNC, Manipur’s apex Naga organisation, urged the Centre to immediately end the “policy of appeasement and protection of militant groups” carrying out attacks and killings, and to fulfill its constitutional and moral responsibility to protect the lives, land, and identity of indigenous people.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The killing of three Thadou church leaders in an ambush in Kangpokpi district on May 13 prompted a series of abductions. The Thadous are divided over their Kuki identity.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: United Naga Council president N.G. Lorho said May 13, 2026, would remain the darkest day in Manipur’s history
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The bodies of six Liangmai Naga civilians were laid to rest in Manipur’s Kangpokpi district on Monday (November 16, 2026), 187 days after they were abducted and subsequently killed almost a month later. The family of the deceased and Naga organisations had refused to claim the bodies — kept at the mortuary of the Jawaharlal Nehru Institute of Medical Sciences in Imphal since June 10 — until their demands were met. One of the main demands of the Naga civil bodies was the abrogation of the 2008 Suspension of Operations agreements with 25 Kuki-Zomi armed groups. The UNC and the families agreed to accept the bodies after receiving assurances of justice at a tripartite meeting involving the Union government, the Manipur government and Naga organisations in Guwahati on September 26, and after the completion of a safer alternative road for the people of Konsakhul village. The families received the bodies on Monday and transported them to their home village of Konsakhul in the Kuki-dominated Kangpokpi district for the final rites. People from various communities gathered for the funeral. Speaking at the funeral, United Naga Council (UNC) president N.G. Lorho said May 13, 2026, would remain the darkest day in Manipur’s history. “On that day, six Naga men were killed, mutilated, and dismembered at Leilon Vaiphei village by KNF-P (Kuki National Front-Presidential), Kuki militants, and Leilon villagers. Their bodies were treated in a manner that brings shame to the State of Manipur and to India before the whole world,” he said. He also noted that the funeral underscored the unity of the Nagas and other indigenous communities of Manipur. “Our land is being invaded and ravaged. Our people are being killed, displaced, and terrorised. If this incursion is not stopped, the very existence, identity, and future of the indigenous people of Manipur will be at stake,” Mr. Lorho said. The UNC, Manipur’s apex Naga organisation, urged the Centre to immediately end the “policy of appeasement and protection of militant groups” carrying out attacks and killings, and to fulfill its constitutional and moral responsibility to protect the lives, land, and identity of indigenous people.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The killing of three Thadou church leaders in an ambush in Kangpokpi district on May 13 prompted a series of abductions. The Thadous are divided over their Kuki identity.

articles.title: Bilkis Bano case: Supreme Court suspends sentence, grants bail to two convicts
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The order published on the court website reasoned that the two men had already been imprisoned for more than 17 years and one of them suffers a severe handicap

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court has granted bail to two convicts undergoing life imprisonment for the gangrape of Bilkis Bano and the murder of her family, including a two-month-old infant, during the 2002 riots. Justices M. M. Sundresh and Prasanna B. Varale suspended the life sentences of Bipinchand Kanaiyalal Joshi and Pradip Ramanlal Modhiya on October 28. The short order, published recently on the court website, reasoned that the two men had already been imprisoned for more than 17 years and one of them suffers a severe handicap. Besides, the court said there were “issues to be decided in the appeal, both on fact and law”. Senior advocate Siddharth Luthra, for the appellants, argued that Modhiya had not been named in the FIR, and was only implicated in the crime after a substantial period of nearly three years. Joshi, who underwent leg surgery, was described as handicapped. "Additional Solicitor General Raja Thakre and counsels for Gujarat and Maharashtra, Swati Ghildayal and Aaditya Aniruddha Pande, objected to the plea for bail and suspension of sentence. They argued that the offence was very serious, and their conviction by the trial court was confirmed in the High Court. “Having heard the parties, it suffices to state that the appellants have been under incarceration for a period of more than 17 years, and also the fact remains that one of the appellants has a severe handicap. Certainly, there are issues to be decided in the appeal, both on fact and law. In view of the above and considering the issues involved in this appeal, we suspend the sentence and grant bail to the appellants on such terms and conditions as may be imposed by the trial court,” the Bench ordered. The interim order was passed in an appeal filed by the two men against a May 2017 judgment of the Bombay High Court upholding their life sentences. A CBI Special Judge in Greater Mumbai had convicted the 11 men and sentenced them to life imprisonment in January 2008. In 2024, the apex court quashed the order of en masse remission granted by the State of Gujarat in August 2022 to the 11 men. The case was transferred by the Supreme Court in August 2004 from Gujarat to Maharashtra after noting that Ms. Bano had been “coerced to live the life of a nomad and an orphan… the gruesome and horrific acts of violence have left an indelible imprint on her mind which will continue to torment and cripple her”.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: court / crime / India / crime, law and justice / sexual assault / riots

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Bilkis Bano case: Supreme Court suspends sentence, grants bail to two convicts

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 06:42:18 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The order published on the court website reasoned that the two men had already been imprisoned for more than 17 years and one of them suffers a severe handicap

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court has granted bail to two convicts undergoing life imprisonment for the gangrape of Bilkis Bano and the murder of her family, including a two-month-old infant, during the 2002 riots. Justices M. M. Sundresh and Prasanna B. Varale suspended the life sentences of Bipinchand Kanaiyalal Joshi and Pradip Ramanlal Modhiya on October 28. The short order, published recently on the court website, reasoned that the two men had already been imprisoned for more than 17 years and one of them suffers a severe handicap. Besides, the court said there were “issues to be decided in the appeal, both on fact and law”. Senior advocate Siddharth Luthra, for the appellants, argued that Modhiya had not been named in the FIR, and was only implicated in the crime after a substantial period of nearly three years. Joshi, who underwent leg surgery, was described as handicapped. "Additional Solicitor General Raja Thakre and counsels for Gujarat and Maharashtra, Swati Ghildayal and Aaditya Aniruddha Pande, objected to the plea for bail and suspension of sentence. They argued that the offence was very serious, and their conviction by the trial court was confirmed in the High Court. “Having heard the parties, it suffices to state that the appellants have been under incarceration for a period of more than 17 years, and also the fact remains that one of the appellants has a severe handicap. Certainly, there are issues to be decided in the appeal, both on fact and law. In view of the above and considering the issues involved in this appeal, we suspend the sentence and grant bail to the appellants on such terms and conditions as may be imposed by the trial court,” the Bench ordered. The interim order was passed in an appeal filed by the two men against a May 2017 judgment of the Bombay High Court upholding their life sentences. A CBI Special Judge in Greater Mumbai had convicted the 11 men and sentenced them to life imprisonment in January 2008. In 2024, the apex court quashed the order of en masse remission granted by the State of Gujarat in August 2022 to the 11 men. The case was transferred by the Supreme Court in August 2004 from Gujarat to Maharashtra after noting that Ms. Bano had been “coerced to live the life of a nomad and an orphan… the gruesome and horrific acts of violence have left an indelible imprint on her mind which will continue to torment and cripple her”.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: court / crime / India / crime, law and justice / sexual assault / riots

articles.title: Export duty on diesel hiked ₹2.5/litre, ATF ₹1.5/litre, petrol remains nil
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The government late Monday (November 16, 2026) hiked the export duty on diesel and aviation turbine fuel (ATF) by ₹2.5 per litre and ₹1.5 per litre, whilst keeping the levy on export of petrol unchanged at nil.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Duty rates on petrol and diesel meant for domestic consumption remain unchanged. The hike in diesel levy assumes added significance as India looks to further up their exports of the vehicular fuel to Europe amid a global supply crunch. In the upcoming fortnight, diesel exports would draw a levy of ₹14 per litre compared to ₹11.5 per litre mandated for the previous fortnight. ATF exports would draw a levy of ₹12.5 per litre against ₹11 per litre. The government has been conducting a fortnightly review of export levies since March 27, in the backdrop of the conflict in West Asia. These are done based on the average international benchmark prices of crude oil, petrol, diesel and ATF observed since the previous review.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: This is to ensure the domestic availability of retail fuels by disincentivising exports.

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #17 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Export duty on diesel hiked ₹2.5/litre, ATF ₹1.5/litre, petrol remains nil

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 08:34:06 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The government late Monday (November 16, 2026) hiked the export duty on diesel and aviation turbine fuel (ATF) by ₹2.5 per litre and ₹1.5 per litre, whilst keeping the levy on export of petrol unchanged at nil.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Duty rates on petrol and diesel meant for domestic consumption remain unchanged. The hike in diesel levy assumes added significance as India looks to further up their exports of the vehicular fuel to Europe amid a global supply crunch. In the upcoming fortnight, diesel exports would draw a levy of ₹14 per litre compared to ₹11.5 per litre mandated for the previous fortnight. ATF exports would draw a levy of ₹12.5 per litre against ₹11 per litre. The government has been conducting a fortnightly review of export levies since March 27, in the backdrop of the conflict in West Asia. These are done based on the average international benchmark prices of crude oil, petrol, diesel and ATF observed since the previous review.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: This is to ensure the domestic availability of retail fuels by disincentivising exports.

articles.title: News Analysis | Drone warfare leaves no safe zones in Sudan
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Unmanned strikes are reshaping warfare, disrupting supply lines and expanding the battlefield into previously secure areas. Markets, hospitals, transport hubs, and homes are increasingly targeted, heightening civilian risk amid a deepening humanitarian crisis

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: On October 18, there was a drone strike on a crowded transport hub near a market in Al-Dibab, a city in the West Kordofan State of Sudan. After ten minutes, a second drone struck the same place, and at least 139 people died in the attack. Eight days later, there was another drone strike in a market in Nyala, the capital city of South Darfur, killing over 100 people, according to the rights group, Emergency Lawyers.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: These attacks point to the emergence of a concerning trend in the ongoing civil war in Sudan. What began as a fight for political supremacy between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) in April 2023 is gradually evolving into a warfare campaign that heavily relies on unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV).

hinglishTracks.en: Eight days later, there was another drone strike in a market in Nyala, the capital city of South Darfur, killing over 100 people, according to the rights group, Emergency Lawyers.

hinglishTracks.en: What began as a fight for political supremacy between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) in April 2023 is gradually evolving into a warfare campaign that heavily relies on unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अप्रैल 2023 में सूडानी सशस्त्र बलों (एसएएफ) और अर्धसैनिक रैपिड सपोर्ट फोर्सेज (आरएसएफ) के बीच राजनीतिक वर्चस्व की लड़ाई के रूप में शुरू हुई लड़ाई धीरे-धीरे एक युद्ध अभियान में विकसित हो रही है जो मानव रहित हवाई वाहनों (यूएवी) पर बहुत अधिक निर्भर करती है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Political' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: राजनीतिक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Political' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Unmanned strikes are reshaping warfare, disrupting supply lines and expanding the battlefield into previously secure areas. Markets, hospitals, transport hubs, and homes are increasingly targeted, heightening civilian risk amid a deepening humanitarian crisis

After ten minutes, a second drone struck the same place, and at least 139 people died in the attack. Eight days later, there was another drone strike in a market in Nyala, the capital city of South Darfur, killing over 100 people, according to the rights group, Emergency Lawyers.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: These attacks point to the emergence of a concerning trend in the ongoing civil war in Sudan. What began as a fight for political supremacy between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) in April 2023 is gradually evolving into a warfare campaign that heavily relies on unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV).

articles.title: ‘ISKCON’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Gorak Nath’: 287 ‘other’ religions briefly listed on Census portal
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The drop-down menu under the ‘Others’ category in the question pertaining to the respondent’s religion had 287 options for those not choosing from among the six major religions in India. After The Hindu raised a query about the classification, the drop-down menu was removed from the portal.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Going by the government's initial classification of “other” religions in the self-enumeration portal for the Population Enumeration phase of Census 2027 , ‘ISKCON’, ‘Ramakrishna Paramahans’, ‘Sanatan’, ‘Shri Ram’, ‘Shri Krishna’, ‘Balmiki’, ‘Ramdev’, ‘Bishnoi’, ‘Sarna’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Yogi’, ‘Shia’, ‘Sunni’, ‘Methodist’, and ‘Pentecostal’, are among the religions practised in the country. While these were among 287 options given under the ‘Others’ category for the question pertaining to the respondent's religion in the self-enumeration portal that went live on Monday (November 16, 2026) for four poll-bound States, the drop-down menu with these options was removed later in the day after The Hindu raised a query with the Union Ministry of Home Affairs regarding the classification. Along the same lines as the previous Census exercises, there are seven main categories in the religion column: Hindu, Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, and Others. In a first, the 'Others' category had been expanded into at least 287 further options, many of which have previously been classified by the Indian government as sects within the six major religions or as respondents’ entries in the “other religions and persuasions” category in the 2001 and 2011 Censuses. The drop-down menu also had several options that had not been recorded before, such as ‘ISKCON’, ‘Ramakrishna Paramhans’, ‘Ramdev’, ‘Khalsa’, ‘Tirupati Balaji’, ‘Gorak Nath’, ‘Basaveshwara’, ‘Baldev’, ‘Devi Maa’, ‘Devi Bhakt’, and ‘Dev Samaj’, among others. After the removal of the drop-down menu, a representative of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India (RG&CCI) said that, apart from the six major religions, there is the ‘Others’ category in which the “respondent is free to write any other religion as in previous censuses.” The official also said that it was “incorrect to say the mentioned terms have been shown as other religions”. However, a government official told The Hindu that the list of options had been prepared as "predictive text entries" for the 'Other' religions category to help enumerators fill in the forms without “spelling variations and mistakes” when a respondent mentions any faith other than the six major ones. Giving an example, the official explained that if a respondent said they were a follower of ISKCON, the predictive text list would complete the entry without spelling variations or mistakes. How these appeared as options in a drop-down box is being inquired into, the official said. The self-enumeration portal (se.census.gov.in) went live on Monday (November 16, 2026) for the States of Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Goa, and Punjab, where elections are scheduled to be held in 2027. For the rest of the country, the portal will open in January 2027. A retired Census official told The Hindu that the options in the now-removed drop-down box were “strange”, particularly because there is no previous data to compare them with. The retired official also said that these entries appeared to be sects or movements within major religions. In 2001 and 2011, the tables on classified sects within major religions and respondents’ entries in the ‘other religions and persuasions’ category were tabulated later, after the enumeration was completed. Before the drop-down box under the other religions category was removed, a government official in Uttar Pradesh, who provided training to Census enumerators, said, “The instructions are to record religion from the six mentioned categories. If a respondent chooses the ‘Other’ category, they can pick from the specified drop-down box with more than 280 names, and if the preferred religion’s name is not there, they can enter the name and it will be recorded as is." There has been a sustained movement by tribal communities in Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and West Bengal, calling for a separate religion column for Adivasi faiths, which they asserted was different from Hinduism.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The current Census, which has been delayed by six years with the last one having been conducted in 2011, is being referred to as the first digital Census. It is also the first to enumerate caste and the first to allow self-enumeration. The Office of the RG&CCI has decided to use an open column for caste enumeration despite demands and protests for a drop-down box of all castes. The government’s justification for using an open column was that there was no single available list of all castes, apart from the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes lists.

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.badge: Analytical Q2 • Key Evidence, Policy & Way Forward
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "‘ISKCON’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Gorak Nath’: 287 ‘other’ religions briefly listed on Census portal"?
options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
The government’s justification for using an open column was that there was no single available list of all castes, apart from the Scheduled Castes...
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: The government’s justification for using an open column was that there was no single available list of all castes, apart from the Scheduled Castes...
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The government’s justification for using an open column was that there was no single available list of all castes, apart from the Scheduled Castes..." (Hinglish Arth: खुले कॉलम का उपयोग करने के लिए सरकार का औचित्य यह था कि अनुसूचित जाति और अनुसूचित जनजाति की सूची के अलावा, सभी जातियों की एक भी उपलब्ध सूची नहीं थी।)

hinglishTracks.en: The drop-down menu under the ‘Others’ category in the question pertaining to the respondent’s religion had 287 options for those not choosing from among the six major religions in India.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — प्रतिवादी के धर्म से संबंधित प्रश्न में 'अन्य' श्रेणी के अंतर्गत ड्रॉप-डाउन मेनू में भारत के छह प्रमुख धर्मों में से नहीं चुनने वालों के लिए 287 विकल्प थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: After The Hindu raised a query about the classification, the drop-down menu was removed from the portal.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — द हिंदू द्वारा वर्गीकरण के बारे में प्रश्न उठाए जाने के बाद, ड्रॉप-डाउन मेनू को पोर्टल से हटा दिया गया था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Classification' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Classification' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Going by the government's initial classification of “other” religions in the self-enumeration portal for the Population Enumeration phase of Census 2027 , ‘ISKCON’, ‘Ramakrishna Paramahans’, ‘Sanatan’, ‘Shri Ram’, ‘Shri Krishna’, ‘Balmiki’, ‘Ramdev’, ‘Bishnoi’, ‘Sarna’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Yogi’, ‘Shia’, ‘Sunni’, ‘Methodist’, and ‘Pentecostal’, are among the religions practised in the country.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — जनगणना 2027 के जनसंख्या गणना चरण के लिए स्व-गणना पोर्टल में "अन्य" धर्मों के सरकार के प्रारंभिक वर्गीकरण के अनुसार, 'इस्कॉन', 'रामकृष्ण परमहंस', 'सनातन', 'श्री राम', 'श्री कृष्ण', 'बाल्मीकि', 'रामदेव', 'बिश्नोई', 'सरना', 'तांत्रिक', 'योगी', 'शिया', 'सुन्नी', 'मेथोडिस्ट' और 'पेंटेकोस्टल', देश में प्रचलित धर्मों में से हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Classification' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Classification' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: While these were among 287 options given under the ‘Others’ category for the question pertaining to the respondent's religion in the self-enumeration portal that went live on Monday (November 16, 2026) for four poll-bound States, the drop-down menu with these options was removed later in the day after The Hindu raised a query with the Union Ministry of Home Affairs regarding the classification.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — जबकि ये आत्म-गणना पोर्टल में प्रतिवादी के धर्म से संबंधित प्रश्न के लिए 'अन्य' श्रेणी के तहत दिए गए 287 विकल्पों में से थे, जो सोमवार (16 नवंबर, 2026) को चार चुनावी राज्यों के लिए लाइव हो गए थे, इन विकल्पों के साथ ड्रॉप-डाउन मेनू को बाद में दिन में हटा दिया गया था जब द हिंदू ने वर्गीकरण के संबंध में केंद्रीय गृह मंत्रालय के साथ एक प्रश्न उठाया था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Classification' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Classification' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Along the same lines as the previous Census exercises, there are seven main categories in the religion column: Hindu, Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, and Others.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — पिछली जनगणना अभ्यास की तरह ही, धर्म कॉलम में सात मुख्य श्रेणियां हैं: हिंदू, मुस्लिम, ईसाई, सिख, बौद्ध, जैन और अन्य।।

hinglishTracks.en: In a first, the 'Others' category had been expanded into at least 287 further options, many of which have previously been classified by the Indian government as sects within the six major religions or as respondents’ entries in the “other religions and persuasions” category in the 2001 and 2011 Censuses.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — सबसे पहले, 'अन्य' श्रेणी को कम से कम 287 अतिरिक्त विकल्पों में विस्तारित किया गया था, जिनमें से कई को पहले भारत सरकार द्वारा छह प्रमुख धर्मों के भीतर संप्रदायों के रूप में या 2001 और 2011 की जनगणना में "अन्य धर्मों और अनुनय" श्रेणी में उत्तरदाताओं की प्रविष्टियों के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Classification' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Classification' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The drop-down menu also had several options that had not been recorded before, such as ‘ISKCON’, ‘Ramakrishna Paramhans’, ‘Ramdev’, ‘Khalsa’, ‘Tirupati Balaji’, ‘Gorak Nath’, ‘Basaveshwara’, ‘Baldev’, ‘Devi Maa’, ‘Devi Bhakt’, and ‘Dev Samaj’, among others.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — ड्रॉप-डाउन मेनू में कई विकल्प भी थे जो पहले दर्ज नहीं किए गए थे, जैसे 'इस्कॉन', 'रामकृष्ण परमहंस', 'रामदेव', 'खालसा', 'तिरुपति बालाजी', 'गोरक नाथ', 'बसवेश्वर', 'बलदेव', 'देवी मां', 'देवी भक्त' और 'देव समाज', और अन्य।।

hinglishTracks.en: After the removal of the drop-down menu, a representative of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India (RG&CCI) said that, apart from the six major religions, there is the ‘Others’ category in which the “respondent is free to write any other religion as in previous censuses.” The official also said that it was “incorrect to say the mentioned terms have been shown as other religions”.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — ड्रॉप-डाउन मेनू को हटाने के बाद, भारत के रजिस्ट्रार जनरल और जनगणना आयुक्त (आरजी एंड सीसीआई) के एक प्रतिनिधि ने कहा कि, छह प्रमुख धर्मों के अलावा, 'अन्य' श्रेणी है जिसमें "प्रतिवादी पिछले जनगणनाओं की तरह किसी भी अन्य धर्म को लिखने के लिए स्वतंत्र है।" अधिकारी ने यह भी कहा कि "यह कहना गलत है कि उल्लिखित शब्दों को अन्य धर्मों के रूप में दिखाया गया है"।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Representative' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Representative' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: However, a government official told The Hindu that the list of options had been prepared as "predictive text entries" for the 'Other' religions category to help enumerators fill in the forms without “spelling variations and mistakes” when a respondent mentions any faith other than the six major ones.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — हालाँकि, एक सरकारी अधिकारी ने द हिंदू को बताया कि विकल्पों की सूची 'अन्य' धर्म श्रेणी के लिए "भविष्य कहनेवाला पाठ प्रविष्टियों" के रूप में तैयार की गई थी, ताकि गणनाकर्ताओं को "वर्तनी भिन्नता और गलतियों" के बिना फॉर्म भरने में मदद मिल सके, जब कोई प्रतिवादी छह प्रमुख धर्मों के अलावा किसी अन्य धर्म का उल्लेख करता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Predictably' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably और Antonyms हैं: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly।

hinglishTracks.en: Giving an example, the official explained that if a respondent said they were a follower of ISKCON, the predictive text list would complete the entry without spelling variations or mistakes.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — एक उदाहरण देते हुए, अधिकारी ने समझाया कि यदि कोई उत्तरदाता कहता है कि वह इस्कॉन का अनुयायी है, तो पूर्वानुमानित पाठ सूची वर्तनी भिन्नता या गलतियों के बिना प्रविष्टि को पूरा कर देगी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Predictably' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably और Antonyms हैं: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly।

hinglishTracks.en: How these appeared as options in a drop-down box is being inquired into, the official said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — अधिकारी ने कहा कि ड्रॉप-डाउन बॉक्स में ये विकल्प के रूप में कैसे दिखाई दिए, इसकी जांच की जा रही है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The self-enumeration portal (se.census.gov.in) went live on Monday (November 16, 2026) for the States of Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Goa, and Punjab, where elections are scheduled to be held in 2027.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — स्व-गणना पोर्टल (se.census.gov.in) उत्तर प्रदेश, उत्तराखंड, गोवा और पंजाब राज्यों के लिए सोमवार (16 नवंबर, 2026) को लाइव हो गया, जहां 2027 में चुनाव होने हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: For the rest of the country, the portal will open in January 2027.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — देश के बाकी हिस्सों के लिए पोर्टल जनवरी 2027 में खुलेगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: A retired Census official told The Hindu that the options in the now-removed drop-down box were “strange”, particularly because there is no previous data to compare them with.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — एक सेवानिवृत्त जनगणना अधिकारी ने द हिंदू को बताया कि अब हटाए गए ड्रॉप-डाउन बॉक्स में विकल्प "अजीब" थे, खासकर इसलिए क्योंकि उनकी तुलना करने के लिए कोई पिछला डेटा नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The retired official also said that these entries appeared to be sects or movements within major religions.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — सेवानिवृत्त अधिकारी ने यह भी कहा कि ये प्रविष्टियाँ प्रमुख धर्मों के भीतर संप्रदायों या आंदोलनों की प्रतीत होती हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: In 2001 and 2011, the tables on classified sects within major religions and respondents’ entries in the ‘other religions and persuasions’ category were tabulated later, after the enumeration was completed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — 2001 और 2011 में, गणना पूरी होने के बाद, प्रमुख धर्मों के भीतर वर्गीकृत संप्रदायों और 'अन्य धर्मों और अनुनय' श्रेणी में उत्तरदाताओं की प्रविष्टियों की तालिकाएँ बाद में सारणीबद्ध की गईं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Classification' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Classification' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Before the drop-down box under the other religions category was removed, a government official in Uttar Pradesh, who provided training to Census enumerators, said, “The instructions are to record religion from the six mentioned categories.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अन्य धर्मों की श्रेणी के तहत ड्रॉप-डाउन बॉक्स हटाए जाने से पहले, उत्तर प्रदेश के एक सरकारी अधिकारी, जिन्होंने जनगणना गणनाकर्ताओं को प्रशिक्षण प्रदान किया था, ने कहा, “निर्देश छह उल्लिखित श्रेणियों से धर्म को रिकॉर्ड करने के लिए हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: If a respondent chooses the ‘Other’ category, they can pick from the specified drop-down box with more than 280 names, and if the preferred religion’s name is not there, they can enter the name and it will be recorded as is."

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 ‘ISKCON’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Gorak Nath’: 287 ‘other’ religions briefly listed on Census portal

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 08:38:16 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The drop-down menu under the ‘Others’ category in the question pertaining to the respondent’s religion had 287 options for those not choosing from among the six major religions in India. After The Hindu raised a query about the classification, the drop-down menu was removed from the portal.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Going by the government's initial classification of “other” religions in the self-enumeration portal for the Population Enumeration phase of Census 2027 , ‘ISKCON’, ‘Ramakrishna Paramahans’, ‘Sanatan’, ‘Shri Ram’, ‘Shri Krishna’, ‘Balmiki’, ‘Ramdev’, ‘Bishnoi’, ‘Sarna’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Yogi’, ‘Shia’, ‘Sunni’, ‘Methodist’, and ‘Pentecostal’, are among the religions practised in the country. While these were among 287 options given under the ‘Others’ category for the question pertaining to the respondent's religion in the self-enumeration portal that went live on Monday (November 16, 2026) for four poll-bound States, the drop-down menu with these options was removed later in the day after The Hindu raised a query with the Union Ministry of Home Affairs regarding the classification. Along the same lines as the previous Census exercises, there are seven main categories in the religion column: Hindu, Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, and Others. In a first, the 'Others' category had been expanded into at least 287 further options, many of which have previously been classified by the Indian government as sects within the six major religions or as respondents’ entries in the “other religions and persuasions” category in the 2001 and 2011 Censuses. The drop-down menu also had several options that had not been recorded before, such as ‘ISKCON’, ‘Ramakrishna Paramhans’, ‘Ramdev’, ‘Khalsa’, ‘Tirupati Balaji’, ‘Gorak Nath’, ‘Basaveshwara’, ‘Baldev’, ‘Devi Maa’, ‘Devi Bhakt’, and ‘Dev Samaj’, among others. After the removal of the drop-down menu, a representative of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India (RG&CCI) said that, apart from the six major religions, there is the ‘Others’ category in which the “respondent is free to write any other religion as in previous censuses.” The official also said that it was “incorrect to say the mentioned terms have been shown as other religions”. However, a government official told The Hindu that the list of options had been prepared as "predictive text entries" for the 'Other' religions category to help enumerators fill in the forms without “spelling variations and mistakes” when a respondent mentions any faith other than the six major ones. Giving an example, the official explained that if a respondent said they were a follower of ISKCON, the predictive text list would complete the entry without spelling variations or mistakes. How these appeared as options in a drop-down box is being inquired into, the official said. The self-enumeration portal (se.census.gov.in) went live on Monday (November 16, 2026) for the States of Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Goa, and Punjab, where elections are scheduled to be held in 2027. For the rest of the country, the portal will open in January 2027. A retired Census official told The Hindu that the options in the now-removed drop-down box were “strange”, particularly because there is no previous data to compare them with. The retired official also said that these entries appeared to be sects or movements within major religions. In 2001 and 2011, the tables on classified sects within major religions and respondents’ entries in the ‘other religions and persuasions’ category were tabulated later, after the enumeration was completed. Before the drop-down box under the other religions category was removed, a government official in Uttar Pradesh, who provided training to Census enumerators, said, “The instructions are to record religion from the six mentioned categories. If a respondent chooses the ‘Other’ category, they can pick from the specified drop-down box with more than 280 names, and if the preferred religion’s name is not there, they can enter the name and it will be recorded as is." There has been a sustained movement by tribal communities in Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and West Bengal, calling for a separate religion column for Adivasi faiths, which they asserted was different from Hinduism.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The current Census, which has been delayed by six years with the last one having been conducted in 2011, is being referred to as the first digital Census. It is also the first to enumerate caste and the first to allow self-enumeration. The Office of the RG&CCI has decided to use an open column for caste enumeration despite demands and protests for a drop-down box of all castes. The government’s justification for using an open column was that there was no single available list of all castes, apart from the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes lists.

✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. articles.title: Tokyo lodges protest after aircraft believed to be Russian violate Japan airspace
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The last confirmed violation of ‌Japan’s airspace by Russian aircraft ​was off Rebun Island, Hokkaido, in ⁠September 2024, according to the ⁠Defence Ministry

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Japan ⁠lodged a strong protest to Moscow on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) after ‌two aircraft believed to be ‌Russian violated Japanese airspace ‌off ⁠Fukuoka prefecture’s ⁠Okinoshima island in southwestern Japan, Japanese Chief Cabinet Secretary Minoru ​Kihara said. “The ‌violation of Japan’s airspace by Russian aircraft is a serious infringement ‌of Japan’s sovereignty. ​It also threatens our safety and ⁠is completely unacceptable,” Mr. Kihara said. “We lodged a ‌strong protest with Russia and urged it to prevent a recurrence.”
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The last confirmed violation of ‌Japan’s airspace by Russian aircraft ​was off Rebun Island, Hokkaido, in ⁠September 2024, according to the ⁠Defence Ministry.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A technical issue at JPMorgan Chase caused problems throughout the financial system on Monday (November 16, 2026), resulting in thousands of customers reporting difficulty accessing online accounts at several major U.S. banks and the money transfer service Zelle.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: JPMorgan Chase, the largest U.S. bank by total assets, said a software bug was affecting its internal hardware systems and causing transaction delays. The company was working to bring banking services back online. Some Chase customers received a message that said, "Some services aren't available. We're working on them. Please try back later." In a sense, yes. Customers at Bank of America, Citigroup and other banks trying to transact with Chase may have seen their transactions slow, even though those banks were not having issues with their services. "Other banks may have been impacted by slowness in transactions only to the extent that they were a party to a transaction with us," explained Joe Evangelisti, a spokesperson for Chase. Zelle was not directly affected by the Chase glitch. But customers at other banks may have experienced transaction delays while trying to send or receive Zelle payments involving a Chase customer. Zelle is a rapid peer-to-peer payment system used by major US banks. The platform is owned by Arizona-based Early Warning Services, which in turn is owned by financial institutions including Bank of America, Capital One, JPMorgan Chase, PNC Bank, Truist, US Bank and Wells Fargo. A spokesperson for Early Warning Services said the Zelle network was fully operational. Chase said that the technical problem was not the result of a cyberattack, stressing that it was an isolated incident and not related to anything other than a bug.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Chase said its customers still have access to their accounts and funds. The company expects the issue to be resolved by the end of day Monday.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #30 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 What to know about the online banking delays affecting major U.S. banks

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 12:51:24 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A technical issue at JPMorgan Chase caused problems throughout the financial system on Monday (November 16, 2026), resulting in thousands of customers reporting difficulty accessing online accounts at several major U.S. banks and the money transfer service Zelle.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: JPMorgan Chase, the largest U.S. bank by total assets, said a software bug was affecting its internal hardware systems and causing transaction delays. The company was working to bring banking services back online. Some Chase customers received a message that said, "Some services aren't available. We're working on them. Please try back later." In a sense, yes. Customers at Bank of America, Citigroup and other banks trying to transact with Chase may have seen their transactions slow, even though those banks were not having issues with their services. "Other banks may have been impacted by slowness in transactions only to the extent that they were a party to a transaction with us," explained Joe Evangelisti, a spokesperson for Chase. Zelle was not directly affected by the Chase glitch. But customers at other banks may have experienced transaction delays while trying to send or receive Zelle payments involving a Chase customer. Zelle is a rapid peer-to-peer payment system used by major US banks. The platform is owned by Arizona-based Early Warning Services, which in turn is owned by financial institutions including Bank of America, Capital One, JPMorgan Chase, PNC Bank, Truist, US Bank and Wells Fargo. A spokesperson for Early Warning Services said the Zelle network was fully operational. Chase said that the technical problem was not the result of a cyberattack, stressing that it was an isolated incident and not related to anything other than a bug.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Chase said its customers still have access to their accounts and funds. The company expects the issue to be resolved by the end of day Monday.

Operational (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Operational' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. articles.title: Singapore seeks ‘trusted access’ to AI chips after new US curbs
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Singapore is finding itself at the centre of the controversy as cloud computing firm Megaspeed, suspected of helping Chinese firms get around US export controls, is based there

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Singapore said Tuesday (November 17, 2026) it was seeking “trusted access” to advanced AI chips after the United States imposed new curbs aimed at stopping Chinese firms from accessing the technology through overseas data centres. The curbs came days after a spy scandal forced Jensen Huang to quit as Nvidia chief, as questions emerged over whether Singapore-based Megaspeed aided Chinese firms in accessing advanced artificial intelligence chips in violation of US rules. “We are studying the details of this new measure carefully,” Singapore’s ministries overseeing digital development and energy, trade and industry said in a joint statement. “We are engaging affected companies to understand the potential impact on their businesses,” the ministries added. The city-state was also talking to the “relevant US authorities on the scope and implementation of the measure, as well as exploring how to facilitate trusted access for Singapore companies”, the ministries added. One loophole allowed Chinese firms to rent AI computing power from data centres in Southeast Asia and elsewhere that run on US hardware not available for export to China. Under the new rule, data centres anywhere in the world will need a US licence to provide large volumes of computing power from advanced chips to companies headquartered in China, Macau or other countries under US arms embargoes. The rule also requires licences to ship advanced chips to Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil, which the US commerce department says present a “higher-than-normal risk of diversion”. Singapore is finding itself at the centre of the controversy as cloud computing firm Megaspeed, suspected of helping Chinese firms get around US export controls, is based there.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Singapore is finding itself at the centre of the controversy as cloud computing firm Megaspeed, suspected of helping Chinese firms get around US export controls, is based there
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Singapore said Tuesday (November 17, 2026) it was seeking “trusted access” to advanced AI chips after the United States imposed new curbs aimed at stopping Chinese firms from accessing the technology through overseas data centres. The curbs came days after a spy scandal forced Jensen Huang to quit as Nvidia chief, as questions emerged over whether Singapore-based Megaspeed aided Chinese firms in accessing advanced artificial intelligence chips in violation of US rules. “We are studying the details of this new measure carefully,” Singapore’s ministries overseeing digital development and energy, trade and industry said in a joint statement. “We are engaging affected companies to understand the potential impact on their businesses,” the ministries added. The city-state was also talking to the “relevant US authorities on the scope and implementation of the measure, as well as exploring how to facilitate trusted access for Singapore companies”, the ministries added. One loophole allowed Chinese firms to rent AI computing power from data centres in Southeast Asia and elsewhere that run on US hardware not available for export to China. Under the new rule, data centres anywhere in the world will need a US licence to provide large volumes of computing power from advanced chips to companies headquartered in China, Macau or other countries under US arms embargoes. The rule also requires licences to ship advanced chips to Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil, which the US commerce department says present a “higher-than-normal risk of diversion”. Singapore is finding itself at the centre of the controversy as cloud computing firm Megaspeed, suspected of helping Chinese firms get around US export controls, is based there.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The scandal erupted on November 8 when The New York Times reported that Jensen Huang and Megaspeed executive Alice Huang -- who are not related -- were romantically linked, and that some within the US government suspected she might be a spy for China.

articles.title: U.S. federal court strikes down fixed terms for student, exchange visas

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: In July, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) proposed a policy aimed at preventing international students from staying in the country for more than four years unless they obtained federal approval

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A U.S. federal court has struck down a Trump administration proposal to cap the amount of time foreign students, scholars, and journalists can spend in the country on their respective visas. In July, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) proposed a policy aimed at preventing international students from staying in the country for more than four years unless they obtained federal approval. Boston federal Judge F. Dennis Saylor delivered a ruling on Monday (November 16, 2026) striking down the DHS proposal as "arbitrary, capricious, an abuse of discretion, and otherwise not in accordance with law." "Put bluntly, DHS is seeking to prevent or discourage the very activity — providing educational opportunities for foreign students in the United States — that Congress sought to permit and encourage," Judge Saylor said in his ruling. "The statute simply does not grant DHS such broad and open-ended authority to undermine the F-1 visa programme," he added. The proposed rule also sought to shorten how long foreign journalists can stay in the country from several years to 240 days – or 90 days for Chinese journalists. The proposed rule also shortened the grace period – the window to depart after finishing studies or post-completion OPT from 60 days to 30. For language programmes, there was an aggregate limit of 24 months for stays, including breaks and vacations. The Foundation for India and Indian Diaspora Studies (FIIDS) welcomed the federal court order.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: "Once again, the court has come to the rescue of international students — and, in doing so, has helped protect the future of American science, technology, research, and innovation," said FIIDS President and Chief of Policy and Strategy, Khanderao Kand.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #22 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 U.S. federal court strikes down fixed terms for student, exchange visas

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 08:02:37 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: In July, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) proposed a policy aimed at preventing international students from staying in the country for more than four years unless they obtained federal approval

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A U.S. federal court has struck down a Trump administration proposal to cap the amount of time foreign students, scholars, and journalists can spend in the country on their respective visas. In July, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) proposed a policy aimed at preventing international students from staying in the country for more than four years unless they obtained federal approval. Boston federal Judge F. Dennis Saylor delivered a ruling on Monday (November 16, 2026) striking down the DHS proposal as "arbitrary, capricious, an abuse of discretion, and otherwise not in accordance with law." "Put bluntly, DHS is seeking to prevent or discourage the very activity — providing educational opportunities for foreign students in the United States — that Congress sought to permit and encourage," Judge Saylor said in his ruling. "The statute simply does not grant DHS such broad and open-ended authority to undermine the F-1 visa programme," he added. The proposed rule also sought to shorten how long foreign journalists can stay in the country from several years to 240 days – or 90 days for Chinese journalists. The proposed rule also shortened the grace period – the window to depart after finishing studies or post-completion OPT from 60 days to 30. For language programmes, there was an aggregate limit of 24 months for stays, including breaks and vacations. The Foundation for India and Indian Diaspora Studies (FIIDS) welcomed the federal court order.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: "Once again, the court has come to the rescue of international students — and, in doing so, has helped protect the future of American science, technology, research, and innovation," said FIIDS President and Chief of Policy and Strategy, Khanderao Kand.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Is the RBI drawing a necessary line between financial inclusion and reckless lending? Is the microfinance industry prioritising loan growth over borrower protection? Are existing credit checks enough to assess a household’s actual repayment capacity?

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story so far: The firm stand of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on the microfinance industry has sent out strong messages that financial inclusion cannot be at the cost of household over-indebtedness and responsible lending begins even before a loan is sanctioned. After two years of contraction, stability appears to have returned in the country’s microfinance sector -- which primarily targets unbanked or underbanked individuals, informal workers, and rural households living below or near the poverty line -- but recovery remains fragile. Industry-wide early-stage delinquency (30-179 days past due) fell to 1.9% in June 2026 from 6.1% a year earlier. However, loans overdue by more than 180 days were high at 17.4%, implying the extent of legacy stress.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — क्या आरबीआई वित्तीय समावेशन और लापरवाह ऋण देने के बीच एक आवश्यक रेखा खींच रहा है?। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inclusive' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: समावेशी — जिसमें समाज के हर वर्ग (खासकर गरीब और वंचित वर्ग) को बराबर शामिल किया जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Egalitarian, All-encompassing और Antonyms हैं: Exclusive, Discriminatory, Narrow।

📰 Pseudo consent, real debt: RBI’s new battle for responsible microfinance | Explained

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 11:24:07 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Is the RBI drawing a necessary line between financial inclusion and reckless lending? Is the microfinance industry prioritising loan growth over borrower protection? Are existing credit checks enough to assess a household’s actual repayment capacity?

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story so far: The firm stand of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on the microfinance industry has sent out strong messages that financial inclusion cannot be at the cost of household over-indebtedness and responsible lending begins even before a loan is sanctioned. After two years of contraction, stability appears to have returned in the country’s microfinance sector -- which primarily targets unbanked or underbanked individuals, informal workers, and rural households living below or near the poverty line -- but recovery remains fragile. Industry-wide early-stage delinquency (30-179 days past due) fell to 1.9% in June 2026 from 6.1% a year earlier. However, loans overdue by more than 180 days were high at 17.4%, implying the extent of legacy stress.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: economy / business (general) / banking / India / Reserve Bank of India / The Hindu Explains

articles.title: ASEAN Summit LIVE updates: PM Modi to participate in ASEAN-India Summit; Quad meeting likely after President Trump arrives

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: In the first Quad Summit since 2024, PM Modi is expected to meet U.S. President Trump, Japanese PM Takaichi and Australian PM Albanese

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to attend the Quad leaders’ meeting, the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit during his ongoing visit to the Philippines, External Affairs Ministry (MEA) spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said on Tuesday. This marks the first in-person, leaders-level Quad gathering since September 2024 in Delaware, as well as the first since Donald Trump returned to the White House. U.S. President Donald Trump flies into the Philippines on Tuesday ‌at the tail end of a Southeast Asian summit. There could be protests in Manila against Mr. Trump’s visit, after days of demonstrations that have included the burning of effigies of the President and calls for an end to ‌the West Asia war and the scrapping of the U.S.-led Pax Silica initiative. Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Tuesday visited the oldest gurudwara in the Philippines and led the foundation stone-laying ceremony for its redevelopment. “The Khalsa Diwan Gurudwara has stood as a testament to the vibrant India-Philippines cultural and people-to-people ties for over a century,” the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said in a social media post. “ASEAN Leaders and their counterparts from ASEAN’s External Partners convene today in Manila, the Philippines, for the final day of the 49th ASEAN Summit,” ASEAN’s X page said. “The meetings provide an opportunity to review progress in regional cooperation, exchange views on regional and international developments, and advance partnerships across ASEAN-led mechanisms,” it added.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: World / India / ASEAN / Live news / Donald Trump / Philippines / Narendra Modi / summit / politics / diplomacy / international relations / negotiation

U.S. President Donald Trump flies into the Philippines on Tuesday ‌at the tail end of a Southeast Asian summit. There could be protests in Manila against Mr. Trump’s visit, after days of demonstrations that have included the burning of effigies of the President and calls for an end to ‌the West Asia war and the scrapping of the U.S.-led Pax Silica initiative. Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Tuesday visited the oldest gurudwara in the Philippines and led the foundation stone-laying ceremony for its redevelopment. “The Khalsa Diwan Gurudwara has stood as a testament to the vibrant India-Philippines cultural and people-to-people ties for over a century,” the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said in a social media post. “ASEAN Leaders and their counterparts from ASEAN’s External Partners convene today in Manila, the Philippines, for the final day of the 49th ASEAN Summit,” ASEAN’s X page said. “The meetings provide an opportunity to review progress in regional cooperation, exchange views on regional and international developments, and advance partnerships across ASEAN-led mechanisms,” it added.

articles.title: Jantar Mantar trespassing case: CJP leaders Das, Ranka to appear before SEM in Delhi
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: This is their second appearance before the magistrate since their release from Tihar jail on October 21; Das was earlier asked to furnish proof of his Delhi address

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Security was tightened at Delhi’s Mandir Marg police station on Tuesday (November 17, 2026), ahead of the appearance of Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka before a Special Executive Magistrate (SEM) court for verification of their sureties, in compliance with the conditions imposed at the time of their release from judicial custody last month. The two had last appeared before the SEM Assistant Commissioner of Police Ritu Raj on October 23, two days after being released from Tihar jail following seven days in judicial custody. They were directed to return on November 17 for verification of their sureties and the accompanying documents. During their October 23 appearance, Mr. Das was also asked to furnish a verifiable document corroborating his present residential address in Delhi, as he had failed to provide any document establishing the same. The SEM court is examining compliance with the conditions attached to their release, including verification of their sureties and supporting documents. At the time of their release on October 21, the two had furnished personal and surety bonds and submitted written undertakings before the SEM that they would not call for any protest at Jantar Mantar as long as it remained a denotified protest site. They also assured the court that they would not engage in any activity that could breach peace. They were directed to appear on every hearing date and comply with the conditions specified in their bonds and undertakings. ALSO WATCH Watch: Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das hit back at funding charges during CJP press meet The proceedings stem from two cases registered on October 13 at the Connaught Place and Parliament Street police stations after 14 CJP members entered Jantar Mantar through private premises and obstructed police personnel. The cases involve allegations of trespass, disobeying a government order and obstructing police personnel on duty, among other charges. They were transferred to the Delhi Police Crime Branch on October 20. The two leaders also appeared before the Crime Branch Branch in Rajouri Garden on November 5, 2026 after being summoned for questioning in connection with cases. Mr. Das and Mr. Ranka were detained on October 13 and remanded to five days of judicial custody the following day. Their custody was extended by another two days on October 19. They were released on October 21 after the SEM court accepted their personal and surety bonds and recorded their written undertakings.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: ALSO WATCH Watch: Saurav Das’s nationality controversy: Madras HC orders response

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Jantar Mantar trespassing case: CJP leaders Das, Ranka to appear before SEM in Delhi

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 11:03:40 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: This is their second appearance before the magistrate since their release from Tihar jail on October 21; Das was earlier asked to furnish proof of his Delhi address

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Security was tightened at Delhi’s Mandir Marg police station on Tuesday (November 17, 2026), ahead of the appearance of Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka before a Special Executive Magistrate (SEM) court for verification of their sureties, in compliance with the conditions imposed at the time of their release from judicial custody last month. The two had last appeared before the SEM Assistant Commissioner of Police Ritu Raj on October 23, two days after being released from Tihar jail following seven days in judicial custody. They were directed to return on November 17 for verification of their sureties and the accompanying documents. During their October 23 appearance, Mr. Das was also asked to furnish a verifiable document corroborating his present residential address in Delhi, as he had failed to provide any document establishing the same. The SEM court is examining compliance with the conditions attached to their release, including verification of their sureties and supporting documents. At the time of their release on October 21, the two had furnished personal and surety bonds and submitted written undertakings before the SEM that they would not call for any protest at Jantar Mantar as long as it remained a denotified protest site. They also assured the court that they would not engage in any activity that could breach peace. They were directed to appear on every hearing date and comply with the conditions specified in their bonds and undertakings. ALSO WATCH Watch: Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das hit back at funding charges during CJP press meet The proceedings stem from two cases registered on October 13 at the Connaught Place and Parliament Street police stations after 14 CJP members entered Jantar Mantar through private premises and obstructed police personnel. The cases involve allegations of trespass, disobeying a government order and obstructing police personnel on duty, among other charges. They were transferred to the Delhi Police Crime Branch on October 20. The two leaders also appeared before the Crime Branch Branch in Rajouri Garden on November 5, 2026 after being summoned for questioning in connection with cases. Mr. Das and Mr. Ranka were detained on October 13 and remanded to five days of judicial custody the following day. Their custody was extended by another two days on October 19. They were released on October 21 after the SEM court accepted their personal and surety bonds and recorded their written undertakings.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: ALSO WATCH Watch: Saurav Das’s nationality controversy: Madras HC orders response

सत्यापन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Verification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

Nationality (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Nationality' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Appearance (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Appearance' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Jantar Mantar trespassing case: CJP leaders Das, Ranka to appear before SEM in Delhi", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. This is their second appearance before the magistrate since their release from Tihar jail on October 21; Das was earlier asked to furnish proof of...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Jantar Mantar trespassing case: CJP leaders Das,' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Jantar Mantar trespassing case: CJP leaders D' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Jantar Mantar trespassing case: CJP leaders D' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "This is their second appearance before the magistrate since their release from Tihar jail on October 21; Das was earlier asked to furnish proof of..." (Hinglish Arth: 21 अक्टूबर को तिहाड़ जेल से रिहाई के बाद मजिस्ट्रेट के सामने यह उनकी दूसरी उपस्थिति है; दास को पहले अपने दिल्ली के पते का प्रमाण प्रस्तुत करने के लिए कहा गया था)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Jantar Mantar trespassing case: CJP leaders Das, Ranka to appear before SEM in Delhi"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. ALSO WATCH Watch: Saurav Das’s nationality controversy: Madras HC orders response.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "ALSO WATCH Watch: Saurav Das’s nationality controversy: Madras HC orders response." (Hinglish Arth: यह भी देखें देखें: सौरव दास का राष्ट्रीयता विवाद: मद्रास HC ने जवाब देने का आदेश दिया)

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Caste, old rivalries and Uttarakhand’s shadow on U.P. Assembly poll

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 10:58:06 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: By invoking the Rajput connection, CM Adityanath has inadvertently brought alive memories of a past when it suited the interests of the two parties to keep the Congress out

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The recent exchange of barbs between Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and Samajwadi Party (SP) President Akhilesh Yadav has brought into sharp relief caste and political equations linking U.P. and Uttarakhand ahead of the Assembly elections in the two States.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Carved out in 2000 under Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) rule, Uttarakhand is set to vote with U.P. in the February-March 2027 election cycle.

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Connection' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Election (Noun)

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

अनजाने में — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Inadvertently' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Decisively, Substantially, Markedly  |  ✖ Ant: Marginally, Slightly, Weakly

✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. B. in the February-March 2027 election cycle.

articles.title: California sues OpenAI, seeking court-ordered changes after the Hugging Face hack
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: OpenAI announced an “unprecedented cyber incident” on July 21, when its AI agent hacked into another AI company, Hugging Face, after escaping from what was supposed to be an isolated testing environment known as a sandbox

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: California’s attorney general filed a lawsuit against OpenAI on Monday (November 16, 2026) in an effort to force the ChatGPT-maker to change its business practices over a July cybersecurity incident in which its artificial intelligence system hacked into another company on its own. In the lawsuit filed in San Francisco Superior Court, Attorney General Rob Bonta alleges that OpenAI misled and endangered the public and users of its services by knowingly developing advanced AI models without necessary safeguards. He says the company’s actions could put critical infrastructure, institutions and the public at risk, which makes it a “public nuisance” under state law. Mr. Bonta says OpenAI is a public nuisance, and he wants a judge to order the company to change its ways and give up any profits generated by what he claims are the company’s risky business practices. OpenAI announced an “unprecedented cyber incident” on July 21, when its AI agent hacked into another AI company, Hugging Face, after escaping from what was supposed to be an isolated testing environment known as a sandbox. OpenAI said its AI used stolen credentials and discovered a previously unknown vulnerability to access Hugging Face’s servers. OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri said the lawsuit appears to single out OpenAI over a challenge that has been identified by every major AI lab. “Since the Hugging Face incident, we’ve undertaken an extensive and transparent effort to understand and address misaligned model activity,” Mr. Pusateri wrote in an email to The Associated Press. Those steps include publishing detailed technical and independent reports, strengthening safeguards, and creating a framework to identify when AI agents act in a way that doesn’t match the company’s instructions or goals, Mr. Pusateri said. “We take misalignment seriously, and we have engaged — and will continue to engage — constructively with the Attorney General’s office to share information and advance strong, practical safety standards for the entire industry,” Mr. Pusateri wrote. In the lawsuit, Mr. Bonta says OpenAI’s promises about safety and security are deceptive. “In truth, however, OpenAI has developed, trained and evaluated dangerous models that fail to follow instructions, cheat on tasks, conceal and attempt to deceive monitors about their misbehaviour, and engage in malicious and unauthorised behaviour including carrying out cyberattacks on third parties,” Mr. Bonta wrote. He also noted that early last month, OpenAI reported that it had discovered that internally deployed agents were able to suppress monitoring alerts and disable monitoring. A month later, the company published a research report finding that as AI models become more capable, they become more difficult to supervise, he wrote.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Moreover, the true extent of the company’s legal violations and the risk of future harm is unknown due to OpenAI’s lack of transparency and misrepresentations,” Mr. Bonta wrote.
