🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Keralam CM announces Tirupati-model mega project for Sabarimala pilgrims

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 01:21:41 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Inaugurating Sabarimala Pilgrim Facilitation Centre at Cochin International Airport, Satheesan says Sabarimala will be developed as part of pilgrimage tourism

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A Tirupati-model mega project for providing modern and comprehensive facilities for pilgrims will be implemented at Sabarimala, Keralam Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan announced in Kochi on Tuesday (November 17, 2026). Inaugurating the Sabarimala Pilgrim Facilitation Centre at Cochin International Airport (CIAL), Mr. Satheesan said that the hill shrine will be developed as part of pilgrimage tourism. “Millions of pilgrims visit Keralam every Mandala season, and the government’s objective is to ensure that all necessary facilities are made available to them. A meeting will be convened after the current Mandala season to discuss the development of long-term infrastructure and facilities at Sabarimala,” he said. The Chief Minister added that the proposed project is expected to increase the number of pilgrims by 50%. “The government’s vision is to develop an interconnected pilgrimage tourism network, encouraging devotees to visit other temples as well rather than returning immediately after offering prayers at Sabarimala,” he said. He said all the measures proposed by various government departments were completed at Sabarimala before the first day of the Vrischikam season which began on Tuersday. “The only concern had been the condition of the Chalakayam road. Following urgent instructions, the road construction was completed within a month and the road was inaugurated recently after completing all formalities. It was one of the roads in Keralam to have been completed in record time,” he said. The Sabarimala Pilgrim Facilitation Centre at CIAL has been established across an area of 5,000 sq. ft. KSRTC bus services are available between CIAL and Sabarimala, with a dedicated booking counter at the centre. Pilgrims can also avail themselves of chartered bus services based on demand. The Chief Minister also flagged off the KSRTC service. A dedicated counter has been set up for helicopter service bookings this season. Other facilities include a Devaswom help desk, prasadam coupon counter, prepaid taxi booking, vegetarian food outlet, air-conditioned rest area and free Wi-Fi. A Flight Information Display System has also been installed to provide real-time flight updates. The centre is located close to the domestic arrival terminal.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Benny Behanan, MP, presided over the function. CIAL managing director S. Suhas and airport director Manu G. also spoke.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Implementation (Noun)
क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना।
✓ Syn: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment  |  ✖ Ant: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation
International (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Comprehensive (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Comprehensive' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Facilitation (Noun)
सुविधा — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Facilitation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Keralam CM announces Tirupati-model mega project for Sabarimala pilgrims", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Inaugurating Sabarimala Pilgrim Facilitation Centre at Cochin International Airport, Satheesan says Sabarimala will be developed as part of...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Keralam CM announces Tirupati-model mega project' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Keralam CM announces Tirupati-model mega proj' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Keralam CM announces Tirupati-model mega proj' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Inaugurating Sabarimala Pilgrim Facilitation Centre at Cochin International Airport, Satheesan says Sabarimala will be developed as part of..." (Hinglish Arth: कोचीन अंतर्राष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डे पर सबरीमाला तीर्थ सुविधा केंद्र का उद्घाटन करते हुए, सतीसन ने कहा कि सबरीमाला को तीर्थ पर्यटन के हिस्से के रूप में विकसित किया जाएगा।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Keralam CM announces Tirupati-model mega project for Sabarimala pilgrims"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Benny Behanan, MP, presided over the function.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Benny Behanan, MP, presided over the function." (Hinglish Arth: समारोह की अध्यक्षता सांसद बेनी बेहनन ने की।)

articles.title: Calcutta High Court issues criminal contempt proceedings against Abhishek Banerjee
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Justice Krishna Rao had said that by his remarks on November 7, Abhishek Banerjee had committed criminal contempt of the court” and “attempted with interference of administration of justice

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Calcutta High Court on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) initiated criminal contempt proceedings against Diamond Harbour MP and Mamata All India Trinamool Congress leader Abhishek Banerjee over his remarks allegedly casting aspersions on a sitting judge. Justice Krishna Rao said that he has gone through the transcript of Abhishek Banerjee’s speech and his facebook post on November 7, which clearly indicates that he has “committed criminal contempt of the court” and “attempted with interference of administration of justice”. He also added that remarks amounted to “scandalising the court”. The court said the alleged contemnor has to explain within 15 days as to why appropriate action should not be taken against Mr. Banerjee. Justice Rao, on November 13, had taken exception to Mr. Banerjee’s remarks, observing that an elected representative and an educated person could not be treated like an ordinary layperson. “You ask your client, who are the judges with the BJP and who aren’t... since he is so intelligent, let him give a list. I will see,” Justice Rao had remarked. The Court had said “Your client is writing the ACR [Annual Confidential Report] of the judges”. On November 7, when a scuffle had erupted outside his residence, Mr. Banerjee claimed that he was attacked seven times in six months and said that he was not granted the desired protection from the judiciary. The residence of Mr. Banerjee was attacked allegedly by BJP supporters in the early hours of November 7 and the three term MP vented his ire against the judiciary. Only a few days ago, the Trinamool MP had said that his party” lost elections not to the BJP but to the Supreme Court of India”. Mr. Banerjee had approached the bench of Justice Rao challenging the State government’s decision to downgrade his security. On the petition of Diamond Harbour MP Justice Rao directed the West Bengal Government to review his security arrangements. The Court directed the Principal Secretary, Home and Hill Affairs Department of the West Bengal government to convene for a review committee meeting within two weeks of the order.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Bengal / Kolkata / court / judiciary (system of justice) / crime

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Calcutta High Court issues criminal contempt proceedings against Abhishek Banerjee

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 01:20:31 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Justice Krishna Rao had said that by his remarks on November 7, Abhishek Banerjee had committed criminal contempt of the court” and “attempted with interference of administration of justice

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Calcutta High Court on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) initiated criminal contempt proceedings against Diamond Harbour MP and Mamata All India Trinamool Congress leader Abhishek Banerjee over his remarks allegedly casting aspersions on a sitting judge. Justice Krishna Rao said that he has gone through the transcript of Abhishek Banerjee’s speech and his facebook post on November 7, which clearly indicates that he has “committed criminal contempt of the court” and “attempted with interference of administration of justice”. He also added that remarks amounted to “scandalising the court”. The court said the alleged contemnor has to explain within 15 days as to why appropriate action should not be taken against Mr. Banerjee. Justice Rao, on November 13, had taken exception to Mr. Banerjee’s remarks, observing that an elected representative and an educated person could not be treated like an ordinary layperson. “You ask your client, who are the judges with the BJP and who aren’t... since he is so intelligent, let him give a list. I will see,” Justice Rao had remarked. The Court had said “Your client is writing the ACR [Annual Confidential Report] of the judges”. On November 7, when a scuffle had erupted outside his residence, Mr. Banerjee claimed that he was attacked seven times in six months and said that he was not granted the desired protection from the judiciary. The residence of Mr. Banerjee was attacked allegedly by BJP supporters in the early hours of November 7 and the three term MP vented his ire against the judiciary. Only a few days ago, the Trinamool MP had said that his party” lost elections not to the BJP but to the Supreme Court of India”. Mr. Banerjee had approached the bench of Justice Rao challenging the State government’s decision to downgrade his security. On the petition of Diamond Harbour MP Justice Rao directed the West Bengal Government to review his security arrangements. The Court directed the Principal Secretary, Home and Hill Affairs Department of the West Bengal government to convene for a review committee meeting within two weeks of the order.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Bengal / Kolkata / court / judiciary (system of justice) / crime

Justice Rao, on November 13, had taken exception to Mr. Banerjee’s remarks, observing that an elected representative and an educated person could not be treated like an ordinary layperson. “You ask your client, who are the judges with the BJP and who aren’t... since he is so intelligent, let him give a list. I will see,” Justice Rao had remarked. The Court had said “Your client is writing the ACR [Annual Confidential Report] of the judges”. On November 7, when a scuffle had erupted outside his residence, Mr. Banerjee claimed that he was attacked seven times in six months and said that he was not granted the desired protection from the judiciary. The residence of Mr. Banerjee was attacked allegedly by BJP supporters in the early hours of November 7 and the three term MP vented his ire against the judiciary. Only a few days ago, the Trinamool MP had said that his party” lost elections not to the BJP but to the Supreme Court of India”. Mr. Banerjee had approached the bench of Justice Rao challenging the State government’s decision to downgrade his security. On the petition of Diamond Harbour MP Justice Rao directed the West Bengal Government to review his security arrangements. The Court directed the Principal Secretary, Home and Hill Affairs Department of the West Bengal government to convene for a review committee meeting within two weeks of the order.

articles.title: Modi government favouring corporates at the cost of farmers: Vijoo Krishnan
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: All India Kisan Sabha (AIKS) national general secretary Vijoo Krishnan urged farmers and agricultural workers to intensify their united struggles against what he described as the anti-farmer and anti-people policies of the Union government.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Addressing the 36th national conference of the AIKS at G.M. Goud Convention Hall in Nalgonda, Mr. Krishnan alleged that the Union government’s economic policies were aligned with American interests. He expressed concern over free trade agreements with the United States, New Zealand and the European Union, warning that they could adversely affect Indian agriculture and threaten farmers’ livelihoods. Mr. Krishnan alleged that the Union government was facilitating the transfer of mineral resources, forests and agricultural land to major corporate groups at nominal prices. He said significant land reforms and redistribution of land to the poor had taken place in States where communist movements were strong or communist-led governments had been in power. Highlighting the plight of tenant farmers, he said they continued to face difficulties in accessing institutional credit, subsidies and compensation for crop losses. Telangana had more than 20 lakh tenant farmers and Andhra Pradesh over 30 lakh, but the respective State governments had failed to provide adequate assistance to them, he claimed. He further said drought conditions prevailed in more than 342 districts across the country and demanded immediate relief measures from the Union and State governments. Mr. Krishnan also criticised the VB-G RAM G scheme , alleging that it could adversely affect the rural poor. He opposed the acquisition of agricultural and forest lands for eco-tourism and other development projects and demanded justice for displaced communities.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Recalling the farmers’ agitation on the borders of Delhi, he accused the Union government of failing to honour the written assurances given when the protest was withdrawn. He demanded implementation of the recommendations of the M.S. Swaminathan Commission to ensure remunerative prices for agricultural produce.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Modi government favouring corporates at the cost of farmers: Vijoo Krishnan

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 01:17:43 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: All India Kisan Sabha (AIKS) national general secretary Vijoo Krishnan urged farmers and agricultural workers to intensify their united struggles against what he described as the anti-farmer and anti-people policies of the Union government.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Addressing the 36th national conference of the AIKS at G.M. Goud Convention Hall in Nalgonda, Mr. Krishnan alleged that the Union government’s economic policies were aligned with American interests. He expressed concern over free trade agreements with the United States, New Zealand and the European Union, warning that they could adversely affect Indian agriculture and threaten farmers’ livelihoods. Mr. Krishnan alleged that the Union government was facilitating the transfer of mineral resources, forests and agricultural land to major corporate groups at nominal prices. He said significant land reforms and redistribution of land to the poor had taken place in States where communist movements were strong or communist-led governments had been in power. Highlighting the plight of tenant farmers, he said they continued to face difficulties in accessing institutional credit, subsidies and compensation for crop losses. Telangana had more than 20 lakh tenant farmers and Andhra Pradesh over 30 lakh, but the respective State governments had failed to provide adequate assistance to them, he claimed. He further said drought conditions prevailed in more than 342 districts across the country and demanded immediate relief measures from the Union and State governments. Mr. Krishnan also criticised the VB-G RAM G scheme , alleging that it could adversely affect the rural poor. He opposed the acquisition of agricultural and forest lands for eco-tourism and other development projects and demanded justice for displaced communities.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Recalling the farmers’ agitation on the borders of Delhi, he accused the Union government of failing to honour the written assurances given when the protest was withdrawn. He demanded implementation of the recommendations of the M.S. Swaminathan Commission to ensure remunerative prices for agricultural produce.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Implementation (Noun)
क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना।
✓ Syn: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment  |  ✖ Ant: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Redistribution (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Redistribution' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Agricultural (Adjective)
कृषि — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Agricultural' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Modi government favouring corporates at the cost of farmers: Vijoo Krishnan", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. All India Kisan Sabha (AIKS) national general secretary Vijoo Krishnan urged farmers and agricultural workers to intensify their united struggles...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Modi government favouring corporates at the cost' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Modi government favouring corporates at the c' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Modi government favouring corporates at the c' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "All India Kisan Sabha (AIKS) national general secretary Vijoo Krishnan urged farmers and agricultural workers to intensify their united struggles..." (Hinglish Arth: अखिल भारतीय किसान सभा (एआईकेएस) के राष्ट्रीय महासचिव विजू कृष्णन ने किसानों और कृषि श्रमिकों से आग्रह किया कि वे टी की किसान विरोधी और जनविरोधी नीतियों के खिलाफ अपने एकजुट संघर्ष को तेज करें।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Modi government favouring corporates at the cost of farmers: Vijoo Krishnan"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Swaminathan Commission to ensure remunerative prices for agricultural produce.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Swaminathan Commission to ensure remunerative prices for agricultural produce." (Hinglish Arth: कृषि उपज के लिए लाभकारी मूल्य सुनिश्चित करने के लिए स्वामीनाथन आयोग।)

articles.title: IND vs NZ Tests: India faces test of character as WTC hopes hang in balance

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: After winning the T20I and ODI series, India turn their attention to the Tests. With conditions favouring pace, Gill and the team management must balance bowling firepower with batting depth

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Basin Reserve, New Zealand cricket’s spiritual home, is often described as the largest roundabout in the Southern Hemisphere. But with India finding itself at a crossroads on multiple fronts, there will be no room for it to go around in circles. Instead, it will have to get its combination right when the first Test begins at the picturesque venue in the heart of Wellington on Thursday (November 17, 2026). One wrong turn could effectively end India’s hopes of qualifying for the World Test Championship (WTC) final. Another could jeopardise its chances of winning a series that, having been truncated to just two Tests in keeping with the demands of modern-day cricket, offers little room for recovery. It could also mean that the 17-year wait for a Test series victory in New Zealand stretches beyond two decades. Little wonder, then, that the Indian think-tank will be hoping the three Cs — combination, courage and climate — go its way. While the last of those remains beyond its control, India will take confidence from the extensive preparations it has undertaken ahead of the series. The top six in India’s batting order — Yashasvi Jaiswal, K.L. Rahul, Devdutt Padikkal, captain Shubman Gill, Rishabh Pant and Ravindra Jadeja — along with pace spearhead Jasprit Bumrah, are virtually assured of their places. It is the remaining four slots that are likely to keep the team management occupied. With the 22-yard strip, which remained covered for large parts of Tuesday (November 17) amid intermittent drizzle, sporting a generous covering of grass, Gill indicated during the pre-series media interaction that India would go in with four pace-bowling options. Yet, given India’s preference for batting depth, it would not be surprising if Dhruv Jurel is preferred as a specialist batter at No. 7 over the all-round abilities of Nitish Kumar Reddy. That would leave India needing to choose two from Mohammed Siraj, Prasidh Krishna, Akash Deep, Gurnoor Brar and Anshul Kamboj. Siraj brings experience to the table, although his place in the pecking order may have come under scrutiny of late. Prasidh offers pace and bounce, having proven his fitness for India A after recovering from a hamstring injury. Akash, returning after a lengthy lay-off, and Kamboj, a nippy swinger, can contribute valuable runs down the order. Then there is Gurnoor, whose impressive showing in the ODI series earned him a place in the Test squad. The lanky pacer offers an X-factor that could tempt the team management to spring a surprise. While the bowlers will have to contend with the challenge of operating into or against the wind on the Basin Reserve’s open expanse, the batting line-up will be expected to carry forward its good work. That is where courage will come into play. And few embody that better than Pant, who could hold the key despite a lack of match practice and being the least acclimatised member of the touring party. The task, however, does not end with getting the combination right. India will also need a sound strategy to crack the Kiwi code. New Zealand has suffered a setback with Mitchell Santner ruled out of the series after fracturing his hand. But with a potent bowling attack and a seasoned batting line-up, the home team remains a formidable opponent. To negotiate the roundabout that is the Basin Reserve and emerge witha series-winning route, India will need more than just sound navigation. India: Shubman Gill (Capt.), K.L. Rahul (Vice-capt.), Yashasvi Jaiswal, Devdutt Padikkal, Rishabh Pant (wk), Dhruv Jurel (wk), Ravindra Jadeja, Anshul Kamboj, Jasprit Bumrah, Prasidh Krishna, Akash Deep, Sai Sudharsan, Nitish Kumar Reddy, Washington Sundar, Mohammed Siraj, Gurnoor Brar.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: New Zealand: Tom Latham (Capt.), Tom Blundell (wk), Devon Conway, Jacob Duffy, Matt Henry, Kyle Jamieson, Daryl Mitchell, Henry Nicholls, Glenn Phillips, Rachin Ravindra, Nathan Smith, Blair Tickner, Will Young, Dean Foxcroft.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 IND vs NZ Tests: India faces test of character as WTC hopes hang in balance

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 01:17:34 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: After winning the T20I and ODI series, India turn their attention to the Tests. With conditions favouring pace, Gill and the team management must balance bowling firepower with batting depth

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Basin Reserve, New Zealand cricket’s spiritual home, is often described as the largest roundabout in the Southern Hemisphere. But with India finding itself at a crossroads on multiple fronts, there will be no room for it to go around in circles. Instead, it will have to get its combination right when the first Test begins at the picturesque venue in the heart of Wellington on Thursday (November 17, 2026). One wrong turn could effectively end India’s hopes of qualifying for the World Test Championship (WTC) final. Another could jeopardise its chances of winning a series that, having been truncated to just two Tests in keeping with the demands of modern-day cricket, offers little room for recovery. It could also mean that the 17-year wait for a Test series victory in New Zealand stretches beyond two decades. Little wonder, then, that the Indian think-tank will be hoping the three Cs — combination, courage and climate — go its way. While the last of those remains beyond its control, India will take confidence from the extensive preparations it has undertaken ahead of the series. The top six in India’s batting order — Yashasvi Jaiswal, K.L. Rahul, Devdutt Padikkal, captain Shubman Gill, Rishabh Pant and Ravindra Jadeja — along with pace spearhead Jasprit Bumrah, are virtually assured of their places. It is the remaining four slots that are likely to keep the team management occupied. With the 22-yard strip, which remained covered for large parts of Tuesday (November 17) amid intermittent drizzle, sporting a generous covering of grass, Gill indicated during the pre-series media interaction that India would go in with four pace-bowling options. Yet, given India’s preference for batting depth, it would not be surprising if Dhruv Jurel is preferred as a specialist batter at No. 7 over the all-round abilities of Nitish Kumar Reddy. That would leave India needing to choose two from Mohammed Siraj, Prasidh Krishna, Akash Deep, Gurnoor Brar and Anshul Kamboj. Siraj brings experience to the table, although his place in the pecking order may have come under scrutiny of late. Prasidh offers pace and bounce, having proven his fitness for India A after recovering from a hamstring injury. Akash, returning after a lengthy lay-off, and Kamboj, a nippy swinger, can contribute valuable runs down the order. Then there is Gurnoor, whose impressive showing in the ODI series earned him a place in the Test squad. The lanky pacer offers an X-factor that could tempt the team management to spring a surprise. While the bowlers will have to contend with the challenge of operating into or against the wind on the Basin Reserve’s open expanse, the batting line-up will be expected to carry forward its good work. That is where courage will come into play. And few embody that better than Pant, who could hold the key despite a lack of match practice and being the least acclimatised member of the touring party. The task, however, does not end with getting the combination right. India will also need a sound strategy to crack the Kiwi code. New Zealand has suffered a setback with Mitchell Santner ruled out of the series after fracturing his hand. But with a potent bowling attack and a seasoned batting line-up, the home team remains a formidable opponent. To negotiate the roundabout that is the Basin Reserve and emerge witha series-winning route, India will need more than just sound navigation. India: Shubman Gill (Capt.), K.L. Rahul (Vice-capt.), Yashasvi Jaiswal, Devdutt Padikkal, Rishabh Pant (wk), Dhruv Jurel (wk), Ravindra Jadeja, Anshul Kamboj, Jasprit Bumrah, Prasidh Krishna, Akash Deep, Sai Sudharsan, Nitish Kumar Reddy, Washington Sundar, Mohammed Siraj, Gurnoor Brar.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: New Zealand: Tom Latham (Capt.), Tom Blundell (wk), Devon Conway, Jacob Duffy, Matt Henry, Kyle Jamieson, Daryl Mitchell, Henry Nicholls, Glenn Phillips, Rachin Ravindra, Nathan Smith, Blair Tickner, Will Young, Dean Foxcroft.

articles.title: BRS hits back at Congress for speaking lies on Tummidihatti in Delhi
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) hit back hard at the ruling Congress for spreading misinformation continuously, including during the recent visit to Delhi, on the issue of construction of a barrage across the Pranahita river at Tummidihatti on the Telangana-Maharashtra border.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Deputy Floor Leader of the BRS Legislature Party and former Minister for Irrigation T. Harish Rao reminded the Congress that it could not get the consent from Maharashtra for seven years when it was in power at the Centre, in Maharashtra and in combined Andhra Pradesh and the then Chief Minister of Maharashtra Prithviraj Chavan had written to his A.P. counterpart N. Kiran Kumar Reddy that any expenditure made on the work would be a waste. After the formation of Telangana, the BRS (TRS) government had requested the Central Water Commission to assess the availability of water at Tummidihatti and based on its report/letter that the water available for use from the point was less. Accordingly, the barrage location was shifted to Medigadda with higher water availability assessed there by the CWC. The BRS government had also scrapped the mobilisation advance system, which enabled contractors and those at the helm of affairs to get commissions without executing any notable work. However, Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy and Minister for Irrigation N. Uttam Kumar Reddy blamed it on BRS in Delhi as part of their lies. It was to cover up their inefficiency and they were targeting the BRS, Mr. Harish Rao said speaking to newspersons at Siddipet on Monday. Ahead of the Chief Minister’s scheduled visit to Siddipet on November 19, Mr. Harish Rao alleged that no good/benefit was done to Siddipet by Mr. Revanth Reddy and instead he had shifted the educational institutions (veterinary college) sanctioned to Siddipet to his constituency — Kodangal. He pointed out that 22,819 farmers of Siddipet constituency were yet to get the benefit of crop loan waiver so far.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In case the Chief Minister had any good thinking for Siddipet people he must announce sanction of veterinary college again, he said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 BRS hits back at Congress for speaking lies on Tummidihatti in Delhi

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 01:15:38 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) hit back hard at the ruling Congress for spreading misinformation continuously, including during the recent visit to Delhi, on the issue of construction of a barrage across the Pranahita river at Tummidihatti on the Telangana-Maharashtra border.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Deputy Floor Leader of the BRS Legislature Party and former Minister for Irrigation T. Harish Rao reminded the Congress that it could not get the consent from Maharashtra for seven years when it was in power at the Centre, in Maharashtra and in combined Andhra Pradesh and the then Chief Minister of Maharashtra Prithviraj Chavan had written to his A.P. counterpart N. Kiran Kumar Reddy that any expenditure made on the work would be a waste. After the formation of Telangana, the BRS (TRS) government had requested the Central Water Commission to assess the availability of water at Tummidihatti and based on its report/letter that the water available for use from the point was less. Accordingly, the barrage location was shifted to Medigadda with higher water availability assessed there by the CWC. The BRS government had also scrapped the mobilisation advance system, which enabled contractors and those at the helm of affairs to get commissions without executing any notable work. However, Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy and Minister for Irrigation N. Uttam Kumar Reddy blamed it on BRS in Delhi as part of their lies. It was to cover up their inefficiency and they were targeting the BRS, Mr. Harish Rao said speaking to newspersons at Siddipet on Monday. Ahead of the Chief Minister’s scheduled visit to Siddipet on November 19, Mr. Harish Rao alleged that no good/benefit was done to Siddipet by Mr. Revanth Reddy and instead he had shifted the educational institutions (veterinary college) sanctioned to Siddipet to his constituency — Kodangal. He pointed out that 22,819 farmers of Siddipet constituency were yet to get the benefit of crop loan waiver so far.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In case the Chief Minister had any good thinking for Siddipet people he must announce sanction of veterinary college again, he said.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Misinformation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Misinformation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Construction (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Construction' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "BRS hits back at Congress for speaking lies on Tummidihatti in Delhi", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) hit back hard at the ruling Congress for spreading misinformation continuously, including during the recent visit to...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'BRS hits back at Congress for speaking lies on T' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'BRS hits back at Congress for speaking lies o' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'BRS hits back at Congress for speaking lies o' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) hit back hard at the ruling Congress for spreading misinformation continuously, including during the recent visit to..." (Hinglish Arth: भारत राष्ट्र समिति (बीआरएस) ने प्राणहिता नदी पर बैराज के निर्माण के मुद्दे पर हाल की दिल्ली यात्रा सहित लगातार गलत सूचना फैलाने के लिए सत्तारूढ़ कांग्रेस पर कड़ा प्रहार किया।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "BRS hits back at Congress for speaking lies on Tummidihatti in Delhi"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. In case the Chief Minister had any good thinking for Siddipet people he must announce sanction of veterinary college again, he said.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "In case the Chief Minister had any good thinking for Siddipet people he must announce sanction of veterinary college again, he said." (Hinglish Arth: उन्होंने कहा, अगर मुख्यमंत्री के पास सिद्दीपेट के लोगों के लिए कोई अच्छी सोच है तो उन्हें फिर से पशु चिकित्सा कॉलेज को मंजूरी देने की घोषणा करनी चाहिए।)

articles.title: Call for cancellation of TNMSC’s tenders for repair works at TASMAC warehouses in Tamil Nadu
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Tamil Nadu Medical Officers Association (TNMOA) has urged the Chief Minister, Health Minister and Managing Director of Tamil Nadu Medical Services (TNMSC) to cancel the corporation’s recent tenders to carry out repair works at warehouses of Tamil Nadu State Marketing Corporation (TASMAC) and to direct that the works be undertaken through the Public Works Department or another agency.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: When TNMSC was earlier made to procure gold coins (for ‘Thaimaaman Thanga Mothiram Thittam’ ), it drew strong criticism. Now, using TNMSC to take up repair works at TASMAC warehouses is strongly condemnable, TNMOA said in a statement. Symbolism or substance? Tamil Nadu’s public health professionals question gold ring scheme Gold ring scheme for newborn babies in Tamil Nadu: Doctors’ body flags high security, logistics costs Earlier, The Hindu had reported that TNMSC has invited tenders for special repairs at TASMAC warehouses in three locations. TNMSC was established to procure quality medical equipment and medicines at affordable cost for the Health department, it said. The association said that already, several irregularities were reported in TNMSC’s core function of procuring medicines. There were repeated instances of TNMSC issuing ‘No Objection Certificates’ instead of procuring essential medicines and asking college deans and joint directors to purchase them using funds under the Chief Minister’s Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS).

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The association expressed concern that instead of addressing the shortcomings and strengthening TNMSC, a model agency in the country, the State government is taking steps that undermine the institution.

articles.title: Air purifier sales surge as demand, smart features drive market growth
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: While Delhi-NCR remains the dominant market, cities like Mumbai and regions beyond traditional high-pollution belts are showing sustained upticks

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Demand for air purifiers in India has witnessed explosive growth in 2026, with major brands and retail platforms reporting sales doubling or tripling year-on-year. Driven by an early surge ahead of the traditional winter pollution season , consumer behaviour is shifting toward viewing indoor air quality as a year-round health priority rather than an emergency seasonal purchase. According to industry leaders, adoption is gaining momentum well before peak pollution months. Smart tech brand Qubo recorded a 150 percent growth over the previous year, while Xiaomi registered approximately 3X year-on-year sales growth during the festive period. Industry executives note that growing awareness surrounding indoor pollutants, ranging from dust and pet dander to everyday cooking and cleaning emissions, is encouraging households to take a proactive approach to home wellness throughout the year. Retail footprint and online traffic reflect this expanding market footprint across the country. Electronics retailer Croma reported that air purifier sales volumes have more than doubled in 2026. While Delhi-NCR remains the dominant market, cities like Mumbai and regions beyond traditional high-pollution belts are showing sustained upticks. Premium tech maker Dyson also reported that visits to its air purifier pages grew by over 100 percent in October compared to the same period last year. Modern buyers are increasingly seeking advanced functionality and intelligent filtration tech. Croma highlighted strong consumer interest in models featuring real-time AQI displays, app controls, and multi-functional units combining purification with humidification or heating. On e-commerce platforms, Amazon India reported that sales doubled over the past week. Shoppers are actively leveraging Rufus, Amazon’s personalised AI shopping assistant, to filter models by room size, filter type, and live sensor capabilities, prompting the e-retailer to expand selection on Amazon Now for immediate delivery.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: technology (general) / gadgets (general) / accessories

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — जबकि दिल्ली-एनसीआर प्रमुख बाजार बना हुआ है, मुंबई जैसे शहर और पारंपरिक उच्च प्रदूषण बेल्ट से परे क्षेत्र निरंतर वृद्धि दिखा रहे हैं। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Sustainability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास। इसके Synonyms हैं: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability और Antonyms हैं: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction।

hinglishTracks.en: According to industry leaders, adoption is gaining momentum well before peak pollution months.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #29 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Air purifier sales surge as demand, smart features drive market growth

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 01:17:42 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: While Delhi-NCR remains the dominant market, cities like Mumbai and regions beyond traditional high-pollution belts are showing sustained upticks

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Demand for air purifiers in India has witnessed explosive growth in 2026, with major brands and retail platforms reporting sales doubling or tripling year-on-year. Driven by an early surge ahead of the traditional winter pollution season , consumer behaviour is shifting toward viewing indoor air quality as a year-round health priority rather than an emergency seasonal purchase. According to industry leaders, adoption is gaining momentum well before peak pollution months. Smart tech brand Qubo recorded a 150 percent growth over the previous year, while Xiaomi registered approximately 3X year-on-year sales growth during the festive period. Industry executives note that growing awareness surrounding indoor pollutants, ranging from dust and pet dander to everyday cooking and cleaning emissions, is encouraging households to take a proactive approach to home wellness throughout the year. Retail footprint and online traffic reflect this expanding market footprint across the country. Electronics retailer Croma reported that air purifier sales volumes have more than doubled in 2026. While Delhi-NCR remains the dominant market, cities like Mumbai and regions beyond traditional high-pollution belts are showing sustained upticks. Premium tech maker Dyson also reported that visits to its air purifier pages grew by over 100 percent in October compared to the same period last year. Modern buyers are increasingly seeking advanced functionality and intelligent filtration tech. Croma highlighted strong consumer interest in models featuring real-time AQI displays, app controls, and multi-functional units combining purification with humidification or heating. On e-commerce platforms, Amazon India reported that sales doubled over the past week. Shoppers are actively leveraging Rufus, Amazon’s personalised AI shopping assistant, to filter models by room size, filter type, and live sensor capabilities, prompting the e-retailer to expand selection on Amazon Now for immediate delivery.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: technology (general) / gadgets (general) / accessories

Premium tech maker Dyson also reported that visits to its air purifier pages grew by over 100 percent in October compared to the same period last year. Modern buyers are increasingly seeking advanced functionality and intelligent filtration tech. Croma highlighted strong consumer interest in models featuring real-time AQI displays, app controls, and multi-functional units combining purification with humidification or heating. On e-commerce platforms, Amazon India reported that sales doubled over the past week. articles.title: Composer Manikandan Ayyappa on the making of his viral hit ‘Ithino Aadame...’
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Composer Manikandan Ayyappa on his viral hit ‘Ithino Aadame...’ from Disco which crossed 23 million views on YouTube, his musical journey and early influences

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The song ‘Ithino Aadame’ from the film Disco has crossed 23 million views on YouTube and is trending across streaming platforms. And the man of the moment is Manikandan Ayyappa, who is at the top of the ‘experimental’ game. “I knew the song would click, but I certainly didn’t expect it to hit this big,” says the composer. The Christian folk song spiced up with Afro-beat loops took the internet by storm three weeks after it dropped. “When director Ullas Chemban described the vibe of the song – the characters, their costumes and the location – I felt it demanded an international appeal. I have been intrigued by African music and this track was born out of an experiment with African rhythm and rap,” he says. Another track from the film, ‘Kaunka’, performed by rapper Veno Miss, also heavily inspired by Afrobeat, is fast climbing the charts. Manikandan, who generally maintains a low profile, is a maverick musician. His debut film song, ‘Kalippu, katta kalippu…’ from Oru Mexican Apaaratha (2017) was a smash hit. Then came ‘Thumbi…’ from Anchakallakokkan (2024), a trance version of Keralam’s folk art/ game, Thumbi thullal — a track that still has a cult following. ‘Theythaka…’, in the vein of a naadan paattu from Kudukku (2025), also became a sensation on social media. Manikandan Ayyappa | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement Manikandan’s songs are known for their distinctive folk flavour, which he attributes to his childhood at Kollannur, a small village in Thrissur. “The earliest influences came from there, especially the sense of rhythm,” he says. Percussion runs in his family. His father KT Ayyappan was a panchavadyam performer and his uncle VC Shankaran was a thavil artiste. “Our village has unique folk art forms and rituals infused with music and rhythm. Growing up in such a setting obviously left a deep imprint in my mind,” says Manikandan. This innate sway had him gravitate towards Carnatic music, learning under reputed musician and composer Narayanan Desamangalam at Chetana Sangeet Natak Akademi, Thrissur.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “My uncle was deeply interested in music and he encouraged me to seek professional training. For a long time, my aim was to become a singer. However, I realised that I didn’t enjoy the performance part of singing. Live programmes still unnerve me. I try to escape it,” says Manikandan, who has sung in films such as Thalavara , and some of his own compositions.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — मणिकंदन अयप्पा | फोटो साभार: विशेष व्यवस्था। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Arrangement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: व्यवस्था — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Arrangement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Growing up in such a setting obviously left a deep imprint in my mind,” says Manikandan.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — मणिकंदन कहते हैं, ''ऐसे माहौल में बड़े होने से जाहिर तौर पर मेरे दिमाग पर गहरी छाप पड़ी।''।

hinglishTracks.en: This innate sway had him gravitate towards Carnatic music, learning under reputed musician and composer Narayanan Desamangalam at Chetana Sangeet Natak Akademi, Thrissur.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — “मेरे चाचा की संगीत में गहरी रुचि थी और उन्होंने मुझे पेशेवर प्रशिक्षण लेने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Professional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: पेशेवर — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Professional' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — काफी समय से मेरा लक्ष्य गायक बनना था।।

hinglishTracks.en: However, I realised that I didn’t enjoy the performance part of singing.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — हालाँकि, मुझे एहसास हुआ कि मुझे गायन के प्रदर्शन भाग का आनंद नहीं मिला।।

hinglishTracks.en: Live programmes still unnerve me.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — लाइव कार्यक्रम अब भी मुझे परेशान करते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: I try to escape it,” says Manikandan, who has sung in films such as Thalavara , and some of his own compositions.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — मैं इससे बचने की कोशिश करता हूं,” मणिकंदन कहते हैं, जिन्होंने थलवारा जैसी फिल्मों और अपनी कुछ रचनाओं में गाया है।।

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Composer Manikandan Ayyappa on the making of his viral hit ‘Ithino Aadame...’

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 03:23:37 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Composer Manikandan Ayyappa on his viral hit ‘Ithino Aadame...’ from Disco which crossed 23 million views on YouTube, his musical journey and early influences

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The song ‘Ithino Aadame’ from the film Disco has crossed 23 million views on YouTube and is trending across streaming platforms. And the man of the moment is Manikandan Ayyappa, who is at the top of the ‘experimental’ game. “I knew the song would click, but I certainly didn’t expect it to hit this big,” says the composer. The Christian folk song spiced up with Afro-beat loops took the internet by storm three weeks after it dropped. “When director Ullas Chemban described the vibe of the song – the characters, their costumes and the location – I felt it demanded an international appeal. I have been intrigued by African music and this track was born out of an experiment with African rhythm and rap,” he says. Another track from the film, ‘Kaunka’, performed by rapper Veno Miss, also heavily inspired by Afrobeat, is fast climbing the charts. Manikandan, who generally maintains a low profile, is a maverick musician. His debut film song, ‘Kalippu, katta kalippu…’ from Oru Mexican Apaaratha (2017) was a smash hit. Then came ‘Thumbi…’ from Anchakallakokkan (2024), a trance version of Keralam’s folk art/ game, Thumbi thullal — a track that still has a cult following. ‘Theythaka…’, in the vein of a naadan paattu from Kudukku (2025), also became a sensation on social media. Manikandan Ayyappa | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement Manikandan’s songs are known for their distinctive folk flavour, which he attributes to his childhood at Kollannur, a small village in Thrissur. “The earliest influences came from there, especially the sense of rhythm,” he says. Percussion runs in his family. His father KT Ayyappan was a panchavadyam performer and his uncle VC Shankaran was a thavil artiste. “Our village has unique folk art forms and rituals infused with music and rhythm. Growing up in such a setting obviously left a deep imprint in my mind,” says Manikandan. This innate sway had him gravitate towards Carnatic music, learning under reputed musician and composer Narayanan Desamangalam at Chetana Sangeet Natak Akademi, Thrissur.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “My uncle was deeply interested in music and he encouraged me to seek professional training. For a long time, my aim was to become a singer. However, I realised that I didn’t enjoy the performance part of singing. Live programmes still unnerve me. I try to escape it,” says Manikandan, who has sung in films such as Thalavara , and some of his own compositions.

articles.summary: 1. Core Context & Background: Composer Manikandan Ayyappa on his viral hit ‘Ithino Aadame...’ from Disco which crossed 23 million views on YouTube, his musical journey and early influences
articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Composer Manikandan Ayyappa on his viral hit ‘Ithino Aadame...’ from Disco which crossed 23 million views on YouTube, his musical journey and early influences
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The song ‘Ithino Aadame’ from the film Disco has crossed 23 million views on YouTube and is trending across streaming platforms. And the man of the moment is Manikandan Ayyappa, who is at the top of the ‘experimental’ game. “I knew the song would click, but I certainly didn’t expect it to hit this big,” says the composer. The Christian folk song spiced up with Afro-beat loops took the internet by storm three weeks after it dropped. “When director Ullas Chemban described the vibe of the song – the characters, their costumes and the location – I felt it demanded an international appeal. I have been intrigued by African music and this track was born out of an experiment with African rhythm and rap,” he says. Another track from the film, ‘Kaunka’, performed by rapper Veno Miss, also heavily inspired by Afrobeat, is fast climbing the charts. Manikandan, who generally maintains a low profile, is a maverick musician. His debut film song, ‘Kalippu, katta kalippu…’ from Oru Mexican Apaaratha (2017) was a smash hit. Then came ‘Thumbi…’ from Anchakallakokkan (2024), a trance version of Keralam’s folk art/ game, Thumbi thullal — a track that still has a cult following. ‘Theythaka…’, in the vein of a naadan paattu from Kudukku (2025), also became a sensation on social media. Manikandan Ayyappa | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement Manikandan’s songs are known for their distinctive folk flavour, which he attributes to his childhood at Kollannur, a small village in Thrissur. “The earliest influences came from there, especially the sense of rhythm,” he says. Percussion runs in his family. His father KT Ayyappan was a panchavadyam performer and his uncle VC Shankaran was a thavil artiste. “Our village has unique folk art forms and rituals infused with music and rhythm. Growing up in such a setting obviously left a deep imprint in my mind,” says Manikandan. This innate sway had him gravitate towards Carnatic music, learning under reputed musician and composer Narayanan Desamangalam at Chetana Sangeet Natak Akademi, Thrissur.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “My uncle was deeply interested in music and he encouraged me to seek professional training. For a long time, my aim was to become a singer. However, I realised that I didn’t enjoy the performance part of singing. Live programmes still unnerve me. I try to escape it,” says Manikandan, who has sung in films such as Thalavara , and some of his own compositions.

The State government has stepped up its preparedness to deal with Cyclone Akvan over the Bay of Bengal. Andhra Pradesh Home Minister Vangalapudi Anitha directed officials to take precautionary measures in all coastal districts to prevent loss of life and property. Andhra Home Minister Vangalapudi Anitha put coastal districts on high alert ahead of Cyclone Akvan’s landfall between Nellore and Tuni, and warned fishermen. Cyclone Akvan is likely to intensify into a very severe cyclonic storm over Bay of Bengal by the morning of 19 November 2026. Very slow north-northwestward movement of Cyclone Akvan over central parts of South and adjoining Westcentral BoB at 0830 IST of today. It will become a Severe Cyclone tonight, moving northwestwards become Very Severe Cyclone on 19 evening, to cross Andhra Pradesh coast around 20th noon. Winds at landfall may reach 120-130 kmph, gusting to 145 kmph. Cyclone Akvan is likely to hit the Andhra Pradesh coast between Nellore and Tuni by noon on November 20 with winds of up to 145 kmph. 🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Cyclone 'Akvan' LIVE updates: Akvan likely to become a severe cyclonic storm by November 19

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 03:22:37 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The clouds associated with the system are projected to bring light to moderate rainfall at some parts of Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Odisha and West Bengal

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Cyclone Akvan brings heavy to extremely heavy rainfall over Tamil Nadu (17–18 November), Coastal Andhra Pradesh (19–20 November), and Odisha (21 November), alongside gusty winds in the Bay of Bengal, according to IMD. The State government has stepped up its preparedness to deal with Cyclone Akvan over the Bay of Bengal. Andhra Pradesh Home Minister Vangalapudi Anitha directed officials to take precautionary measures in all coastal districts to prevent loss of life and property. Andhra Home Minister Vangalapudi Anitha put coastal districts on high alert ahead of Cyclone Akvan’s landfall between Nellore and Tuni, and warned fishermen. Cyclone Akvan is likely to intensify into a very severe cyclonic storm over Bay of Bengal by the morning of 19 November 2026. Very slow north-northwestward movement of Cyclone Akvan over central parts of South and adjoining Westcentral BoB at 0830 IST of today. It will become a Severe Cyclone tonight, moving northwestwards become Very Severe Cyclone on 19 evening, to cross Andhra Pradesh coast around 20th noon. Cyclone Akvan, expected to form over the Bay of Bengal on Monday evening, is very likely to cross the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts between Nellore and Tuni by noon on November 20 as a very severe cyclonic storm, the India Meteorological Department (IMD) said in its forecast on Monday (November 16, 2026). Winds at landfall may reach 120-130 kmph, gusting to 145 kmph. Cyclone Akvan is likely to hit the Andhra Pradesh coast between Nellore and Tuni by noon on November 20 with winds of up to 145 kmph. Check its path here.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Odisha government yesterday geared up for the possible impact of Cyclone Akvan, the third cyclonic storm formed over the Bay of Bengal in three weeks, with the deployment of 74 rescue teams and early evacuation of vulnerable people in the southern districts.

articles.title: ASEAN Summit LIVE updates: PM Modi proposes initiatives to strengthen ASEAN-India ties; Quad meeting likely after President Trump arrives
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: In the first Quad Summit since 2024, PM Modi is expected to meet U.S. President Trump, Japanese PM Takaichi and Australian PM Albanese

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The leaders of the ASEAN countries reaffirmed their commitment to further strengthening the East Asia Summit, with the leaders discussing on national and international developments. Amid ASEAN members grappling with fuel shortages and price hikes, Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi said her country’s “hydro-tanks” would be available for use to the ASEAN countries under the proposed initiative for cooperation on oil stockpiling. Read more: ​ Japan offers ASEAN nations access to energy storage Japan offers ASEAN access to its crude oil storage to bolster regional energy security amid supply pressures. ​ Japan offers ASEAN access to its crude oil storage to bolster regional energy security amid supply pressures. ASEAN leaders have adopted the declaration to promote artificial intelligence (AI)-powered growth among micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs), focusing on affordable technology solutions, digital infrastructure, AI literacy and responsible technology adoption across the region. The declaration recognises that MSMEs form the backbone of ASEAN economies but continue to face challenges in AI adoption. Under the declaration, ASEAN member states have been encouraged to explore voluntary and flexible approaches to assess the AI readiness of MSMEs and identify gaps in their technological capabilities. ASEAN leaders also identified AI literacy as a key requirement for responsible and sustainable adoption. PM Modi has suggested an ASEAN-India Youth Connect initiative involving a youth summit, young parliamentarian exchanges and start-up hackathons, to strengthen people-to-people and youth engagement.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The PM also proposed enhancing scholarships for students from ASEAN countries at Nalanda University.

📰 ASEAN Summit LIVE updates: PM Modi proposes initiatives to strengthen ASEAN-India ties; Quad meeting likely after President Trump arrives

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 03:20:58 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: In the first Quad Summit since 2024, PM Modi is expected to meet U.S. President Trump, Japanese PM Takaichi and Australian PM Albanese

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The leaders of the ASEAN countries reaffirmed their commitment to further strengthening the East Asia Summit, with the leaders discussing on national and international developments. Amid ASEAN members grappling with fuel shortages and price hikes, Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi said her country’s “hydro-tanks” would be available for use to the ASEAN countries under the proposed initiative for cooperation on oil stockpiling. Read more: ​ Japan offers ASEAN nations access to energy storage Japan offers ASEAN access to its crude oil storage to bolster regional energy security amid supply pressures. ​ Japan offers ASEAN access to its crude oil storage to bolster regional energy security amid supply pressures. ASEAN leaders have adopted the declaration to promote artificial intelligence (AI)-powered growth among micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs), focusing on affordable technology solutions, digital infrastructure, AI literacy and responsible technology adoption across the region. The declaration recognises that MSMEs form the backbone of ASEAN economies but continue to face challenges in AI adoption. Under the declaration, ASEAN member states have been encouraged to explore voluntary and flexible approaches to assess the AI readiness of MSMEs and identify gaps in their technological capabilities. ASEAN leaders also identified AI literacy as a key requirement for responsible and sustainable adoption. PM Modi has suggested an ASEAN-India Youth Connect initiative involving a youth summit, young parliamentarian exchanges and start-up hackathons, to strengthen people-to-people and youth engagement.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The PM also proposed enhancing scholarships for students from ASEAN countries at Nalanda University.

articles.title: Dengue spurt in Thiruvananthapuram: KU’s Karyavattom campus, Cliff House compound emerge as hotspots
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Intermittent spells of rain, followed by hot and humid weather, have led to a spike in dengue cases in Thiruvananthapuram, even as the overall trend in dengue cases across the State has been on a slow decline since July

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Karyavattom campus of Kerala University (KU) has emerged as a hotspot of dengue in the city, where over 50 cases have been reported since November 9. Health department suspects that this is a gross underestimation, as the transmission is likely to have begun weeks before Intermittent spells of rain, followed by hot and humid weather, have led to the spike in dengue cases in Thiruvananthapuram, even when the general dengue case trend has been on a slow decline since July across the State. In the last 10 days, Thiruvananthapuram district has reported 200 probable cases of dengue and 97 confirmed cases. On Monday, following a meeting called by the Health department, which was joined by the Vice Chancellor, some KU syndicate members as well as public health experts of the School of Public Health under Kerala University of Health Sciences, it was decided to shut the Karyavattom campus and the hostel buildings for three days so that intense vector control measures can be taken up and a break in disease transmission can be achieved. “District health officials and vector control teams had visited the campus and hostel and we found that solid waste management was a huge issue in the campus. Plastic disposable containers used for food delivery which are disposed of carelessly are emerging as a major contributor to vector breeding in urban areas.. Rain water stagnation in these containers which are strewn around is a major hazard. Indoor plants in hostel rooms, broken manholes and blocked drains leading to rainwater stagnation have all led to intense mosquito breeding inside the vast campus,” a senior Health official said. The Health department has also decided to serve notice to the KU Registrar under the Kerala Public Health Act, for allowing the campus to be a breeding ground for mosquitoes and posing a public health issue Teams from the Pangappara health centre have been at work on the campus since November 10 but the district vector control team and the Corporation health staff will be joining them now. Fogging will be done to kill adult mosquitoes and indoor space spraying inside the hostel room, which will be accompanied by a source reduction campaign, officials said. The district health administration has identified several pockets of dengue within the city itself, where an abundance of breeding sources and intense vector breeding has been spotted Health officials point out that several large government properties with vast, ill-maintained grounds are also turning out to be hotspots for dengue in the city.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The Cliff House compound and the sprawling official bungalows around it are all major breeding grounds for mosquitoes. In the Cliff House, seven police personnel there on guard duty were down with dengue, following which a district health team had visited the location. In some of the bungalows where renovation works are going on, building materials and discarded parts of equipment are all thrown about carelessly, leading to rain water stagnation and mosquito breeding,” a health official said.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #28 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Dengue spurt in Thiruvananthapuram: KU’s Karyavattom campus, Cliff House compound emerge as hotspots

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 03:20:54 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Intermittent spells of rain, followed by hot and humid weather, have led to a spike in dengue cases in Thiruvananthapuram, even as the overall trend in dengue cases across the State has been on a slow decline since July

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Karyavattom campus of Kerala University (KU) has emerged as a hotspot of dengue in the city, where over 50 cases have been reported since November 9. Health department suspects that this is a gross underestimation, as the transmission is likely to have begun weeks before Intermittent spells of rain, followed by hot and humid weather, have led to the spike in dengue cases in Thiruvananthapuram, even when the general dengue case trend has been on a slow decline since July across the State. In the last 10 days, Thiruvananthapuram district has reported 200 probable cases of dengue and 97 confirmed cases. On Monday, following a meeting called by the Health department, which was joined by the Vice Chancellor, some KU syndicate members as well as public health experts of the School of Public Health under Kerala University of Health Sciences, it was decided to shut the Karyavattom campus and the hostel buildings for three days so that intense vector control measures can be taken up and a break in disease transmission can be achieved. “District health officials and vector control teams had visited the campus and hostel and we found that solid waste management was a huge issue in the campus. Plastic disposable containers used for food delivery which are disposed of carelessly are emerging as a major contributor to vector breeding in urban areas.. Rain water stagnation in these containers which are strewn around is a major hazard. Indoor plants in hostel rooms, broken manholes and blocked drains leading to rainwater stagnation have all led to intense mosquito breeding inside the vast campus,” a senior Health official said. The Health department has also decided to serve notice to the KU Registrar under the Kerala Public Health Act, for allowing the campus to be a breeding ground for mosquitoes and posing a public health issue Teams from the Pangappara health centre have been at work on the campus since November 10 but the district vector control team and the Corporation health staff will be joining them now. Fogging will be done to kill adult mosquitoes and indoor space spraying inside the hostel room, which will be accompanied by a source reduction campaign, officials said. The district health administration has identified several pockets of dengue within the city itself, where an abundance of breeding sources and intense vector breeding has been spotted Health officials point out that several large government properties with vast, ill-maintained grounds are also turning out to be hotspots for dengue in the city.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The Cliff House compound and the sprawling official bungalows around it are all major breeding grounds for mosquitoes. In the Cliff House, seven police personnel there on guard duty were down with dengue, following which a district health team had visited the location. In some of the bungalows where renovation works are going on, building materials and discarded parts of equipment are all thrown about carelessly, leading to rain water stagnation and mosquito breeding,” a health official said.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Intermittent spells of rain, followed by hot and humid weather, have led to a spike in dengue cases in Thiruvananthapuram, even as the overall trend in dengue cases across the State has been on a slow decline since July
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Karyavattom campus of Kerala University (KU) has emerged as a hotspot of dengue in the city, where over 50 cases have been reported since November 9. Health department suspects that this is a gross underestimation, as the transmission is likely to have begun weeks before Intermittent spells of rain, followed by hot and humid weather, have led to the spike in dengue cases in Thiruvananthapuram, even when the general dengue case trend has been on a slow decline since July across the State. In the last 10 days, Thiruvananthapuram district has reported 200 probable cases of dengue and 97 confirmed cases. On Monday, following a meeting called by the Health department, which was joined by the Vice Chancellor, some KU syndicate members as well as public health experts of the School of Public Health under Kerala University of Health Sciences, it was decided to shut the Karyavattom campus and the hostel buildings for three days so that intense vector control measures can be taken up and a break in disease transmission can be achieved. “District health officials and vector control teams had visited the campus and hostel and we found that solid waste management was a huge issue in the campus. Plastic disposable containers used for food delivery which are disposed of carelessly are emerging as a major contributor to vector breeding in urban areas.. Rain water stagnation in these containers which are strewn around is a major hazard. Indoor plants in hostel rooms, broken manholes and blocked drains leading to rainwater stagnation have all led to intense mosquito breeding inside the vast campus,” a senior Health official said. The Health department has also decided to serve notice to the KU Registrar under the Kerala Public Health Act, for allowing the campus to be a breeding ground for mosquitoes and posing a public health issue Teams from the Pangappara health centre have been at work on the campus since November 10 but the district vector control team and the Corporation health staff will be joining them now. Fogging will be done to kill adult mosquitoes and indoor space spraying inside the hostel room, which will be accompanied by a source reduction campaign, officials said. The district health administration has identified several pockets of dengue within the city itself, where an abundance of breeding sources and intense vector breeding has been spotted Health officials point out that several large government properties with vast, ill-maintained grounds are also turning out to be hotspots for dengue in the city.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The Cliff House compound and the sprawling official bungalows around it are all major breeding grounds for mosquitoes. In the Cliff House, seven police personnel there on guard duty were down with dengue, following which a district health team had visited the location. In some of the bungalows where renovation works are going on, building materials and discarded parts of equipment are all thrown about carelessly, leading to rain water stagnation and mosquito breeding,” a health official said.

articles.title: Japan offers ASEAN nations access to energy storage
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: ASEAN members have been grappling with fuel shortages and price hikes after the West Asia conflict squeezed the flow of crude to the region

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Japan said on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) that Southeast Asian nations will be able to access its crude oil storage facilities as part of efforts to prepare the region for a future energy crisis. The announcement came as leaders of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) met in Manila, where energy security has been high on the agenda. Keep track | ASEAN Summit LIVE updates: PM Modi at ASEAN-India Summit; Quad meeting likely after President Trump arrives Addressing regional leaders, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said her country's "hydro-tanks" would be available for use under the proposed initiative for cooperation on oil stockpiling. ASEAN members have been grappling with fuel shortages and price hikes after the West Asia conflict squeezed the flow of crude to the region. The regional bloc has previously called for "unimpeded" passage through the Strait of Hormuz, which was closed following U.S.-Israeli strikes on Iran. Under the Japanese POWERR Asia initiative, ASEAN nations will be able to use Japan's excess storage capacity for crude oil. "We have suggested to utilise our crude oil stockpiling facilities in Japan, which is not utilised," Japan's Foreign Ministry press secretary Toshihiro Kitamura told reporters on the sidelines of the ASEAN summit. "By utilising those unused facilities in Japan, we can stockpile the other countries' crude oil and in case of crisis... it's a kind of joint stockpiling system."

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Japan has 254 days' worth of oil reserves, Mr. Kitamura said, while at the outbreak of the West Asia war in February some ASEAN countries had less than a month's worth.
