📰 Kerala Police find similarities between Gurumurthy, Kochi synagogue arson cases; yet to find evidence of Lawrence Bishnoi links

📌 Published: 16 Nov 2026, 01:17:17 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Thrissur police are investigating case against Tamil Nadu native Gurumurthy who was arrested recently from Palakkad for alleged links with criminal networks, while NIA has taken over probe into arson case

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The police in Keralam have found similarities between the case in which a Tamil Nadu native was arrested recently from Palakkad for alleged links with criminal networks and the arson attack allegedly targeting a synagogue in Ernakulam. Initial investigations have revealed similarities in the modus operandi of 27-year-old Gurumurthy, who was arrested from Ottappalam, Palakkad, on November 12, and Ebin P. Paul, 32, who has been remanded in judicial custody since his arrest for allegedly setting fire to a plant nursery located in front of the 800-year-old Kadavumbhagam synagogue in Ernakulam on October 12, State Police Chief Ravada A. Chandrasekhar said on Monday (November 16, 2026). Though the accused in both cases were suspected to have links with the infamous Lawrence Bishnoi gang, the police said they were yet to find evidence of any direct connection between the accused and the group. The Thrissur police are investigating the case against Gurumurthy, while the National Investigation Agency (NIA) has taken over the probe into the arson case. “Initial investigation revealed that Gurumurthy was taking assignments from criminal networks operating mainly through social media. He used to take photographs of various locations and send them to his handler in return for money. He was paid in cryptocurrency and using GPay. The case bears some similarities to the Ebin Paul case, in which an incendiary device was thrown at the synagogue in Kochi. We are examining whether the handler is connected to that case,” Mr. Chandrasekhar told reporters. Another youth was arrested in Mumbai recently for alleged links with Gurumurthy. Yash Singh, 20, a native of Navi Mumbai, was arrested by the Maharashtra Anti-Terrorism Squad for allegedly conducting reconnaissance of Jewish establishments, including Chabad House in Mumbai.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Singh, who was reportedly recruited by Gurumurthy, was later handed over to the Thrissur City police. He was brought to Thrissur on Sunday and remanded in judicial custody.

articles.title: Supreme Court asks Centre, States to file status reports on setting up of special courts to hear NDPS Act cases
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Supreme Court took note of the submissions of Additional Solicitor General Aishwarya Bhati, appearing for the Centre, that not much progress has been made in pursuance of the orders passed by the apex court recently on setting up of special courts

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court on Monday (November 16, 2026) asked the Centre, State governments and Union Territory administrations to file fresh status reports on progress made in the establishment of 449 special courts to hear cases of heinous offences under the NDPS Act. A Bench comprising Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana took note of the submissions of Additional Solicitor General Aishwarya Bhati, appearing for the Centre, that not much progress has been made in pursuance of the orders passed by the apex court recently on setting up of special courts. "This is a three-judge matter also," Justice Bagchi said and referred to the non-availability of Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant for the hearing. The Bench said that it will keep the suo motu case concerning the creation of exclusive special courts for speedy trials under the National Investigation Agency (NIA) Act and the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act after a few weeks and preferably before the winter vacation in December. It asked the Centre, States and Union Territories to file fresh status reports on the progress made by them in creating special courts for early disposal of pending cases under the NIA and NDPS Acts. Earlier, the Bench had expressed concern over the alarming increase in narcotics-related offences across the country and the growing pendency of cases under the NDPS Act. On September 7, the court had directed the Centre, State governments and Union Territory administrations to expedite the establishment of exclusive special courts, preferably within six weeks. According to an affidavit filed by the Union government, 449 exclusive NDPS courts have been identified as necessary across the country to address the mounting backlog of cases. The Centre had told the court that 176 of these courts were already operational.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Taking note of the figures, the Bench had observed that the existing pendency and the "unfortunate, alarming increase" in offences under the NDPS Act made it imperative to establish all the identified courts at the earliest.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (16 NOV)

📰 Supreme Court asks Centre, States to file status reports on setting up of special courts to hear NDPS Act cases

📌 Published: 16 Nov 2026, 01:15:04 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Supreme Court took note of the submissions of Additional Solicitor General Aishwarya Bhati, appearing for the Centre, that not much progress has been made in pursuance of the orders passed by the apex court recently on setting up of special courts

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court on Monday (November 16, 2026) asked the Centre, State governments and Union Territory administrations to file fresh status reports on progress made in the establishment of 449 special courts to hear cases of heinous offences under the NDPS Act. A Bench comprising Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana took note of the submissions of Additional Solicitor General Aishwarya Bhati, appearing for the Centre, that not much progress has been made in pursuance of the orders passed by the apex court recently on setting up of special courts. "This is a three-judge matter also," Justice Bagchi said and referred to the non-availability of Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant for the hearing. The Bench said that it will keep the suo motu case concerning the creation of exclusive special courts for speedy trials under the National Investigation Agency (NIA) Act and the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act after a few weeks and preferably before the winter vacation in December. It asked the Centre, States and Union Territories to file fresh status reports on the progress made by them in creating special courts for early disposal of pending cases under the NIA and NDPS Acts. Earlier, the Bench had expressed concern over the alarming increase in narcotics-related offences across the country and the growing pendency of cases under the NDPS Act. On September 7, the court had directed the Centre, State governments and Union Territory administrations to expedite the establishment of exclusive special courts, preferably within six weeks. According to an affidavit filed by the Union government, 449 exclusive NDPS courts have been identified as necessary across the country to address the mounting backlog of cases. The Centre had told the court that 176 of these courts were already operational.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Taking note of the figures, the Bench had observed that the existing pendency and the "unfortunate, alarming increase" in offences under the NDPS Act made it imperative to establish all the identified courts at the earliest.

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Establishment' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Availability (Noun)
उपलब्धता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Availability' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Psychotropic (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Psychotropic' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Supreme Court asks Centre, States to file status reports on setting up of special courts to hear NDPS Act cases", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Supreme Court took note of the submissions of Additional Solicitor General Aishwarya Bhati, appearing for the Centre, that not much progress has been...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Supreme Court asks Centre, States to file status' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Supreme Court asks Centre, States to file sta' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Supreme Court asks Centre, States to file sta' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Supreme Court took note of the submissions of Additional Solicitor General Aishwarya Bhati, appearing for the Centre, that not much progress has been..." (Hinglish Arth: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने केंद्र की ओर से पेश अतिरिक्त सॉलिसिटर जनरल ऐश्वर्या भाटी की दलीलों पर ध्यान दिया कि शीर्ष अदालत द्वारा हाल ही में पारित आदेशों के अनुपालन में ज्यादा प्रगति नहीं हुई है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Supreme Court asks Centre, States to file status reports on setting up of special courts to hear NDPS Act cases"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Taking note of the figures, the Bench had observed that the existing pendency and the "unfortunate, alarming increase" in offences under the NDPS Act...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Taking note of the figures, the Bench had observed that the existing pendency and the "unfortunate, alarming increase" in offences under the NDPS Act..." (Hinglish Arth: आंकड़ों को ध्यान में रखते हुए, बेंच ने देखा था कि एनडीपीएस अधिनियम के तहत मौजूदा लंबित मामलों और अपराधों में "दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण, चिंताजनक वृद्धि" के कारण सभी चिन्हित अदालतों को जल्द से जल्द स्थापित करना अनिवार्य हो गया है।)

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: He was caught after a chase as he jumped through the window of bus in the dead of night

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nishanth, the prime accused in the November 12 gold heist at the Tanishq jewellery showroom in Madurai , was arrested by the Dharmapuri police early on Monday (November 16, 2026). The police said the driver of an omnibus Nishanth was travelling in grew suspicious of him as he had masked his face. “The driver immediately alerted the Dharmapuri police,” a senior police officer told The Hindu . A team of police personnel from Athiyamankottai intercepted the bus at a checkpost shortly after Sunday (November 15) midnight. Realising that the police had tracked him down, Nishanth jumped off the bus through a window and fled. Tanishq gold heist: CCTV footages, tattoo bring Nishanth into the police net 2 persons held in Tanishq gold heist in Madurai; main accused still at large, say police Series of security lapses led to burglary at Tanishq showroom in Madurai However, the police team apprehended him after a chase. A team of police personnel from Madurai has rushed to Dharmapuri to take custody of the accused.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He is the third accused to be arrested in the case , in which 11 kg of gold and diamond ornaments were allegedly stolen by Nishanth.

articles.title: Wholesale inflation surges to 12.29% in October, fuel and power prices lead rise
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: According to provisional government data, inflation in the fuel and power category climbed to 32.84%, while primary articles recorded inflation of 9.24%. Inflation in manufactured products, meanwhile, eased marginally to 9.54%

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India’s wholesale price inflation accelerated to 12.29% in October 2026, compared with 11.39% in September, according to provisional data released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry on Monday. The All India Wholesale Price Index (WPI) for all commodities rose to 113.3 in October, from 112.5 in the previous month. Fuel and power prices remained the biggest driver of wholesale inflation, with the category recording an annual inflation rate of 32.84% in October, sharply higher than the 25.85% recorded in September. Inflation in primary articles also increased to 9.24% from 8.67% during the same period. Meanwhile, inflation in manufactured products eased marginally to 9.54%, compared with 9.76% in September. Within the fuel and power category, inflation in mineral oils rose to 45.57% in October from 40.02% in September. Crude petroleum and natural gas recorded a sharp increase, with inflation climbing to 70.80% from 57.32%. Electricity inflation also moved into positive territory at 8.06%, compared with -0.43% in the previous month. The government’s data identified mineral oils, crude petroleum and natural gas, electricity, food articles, basic metals, chemicals, food products, non-food articles, textiles, and rubber and plastic products among the major contributors to wholesale price inflation during October. The Wholesale Price Index’s food index, which accounts for 24.99% of the overall basket, recorded inflation of 8.58% in October, marginally lower than the 8.66% reported in September. Inflation in food articles under the primary articles category, however, rose to 8.26% from 8.14%. Among manufactured products, inflation in chemicals and chemical products increased to 17.53% in October from 16.74% in September. Basic metals inflation rose to 17.21% from 16.96%, while textiles recorded inflation of 13.67%, compared with 13.85% in the previous month. Inflation in rubber and plastic products also increased to 13.90% from 13.47%. The Ministry said the October WPI figures are provisional and have been compiled with a weighted response rate of 81.1%. The final WPI inflation rate for August 2026 remained unchanged at 9.92%, with the index at 110.8. The government is scheduled to release the provisional Wholesale Price Index, Output Producer Price Index and trial Input Producer Price Index for November 2026 on December 14.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: economy, business and finance / inflation and deflation

options: According to provisional government data, inflation in the fuel and power category climbed to 32.84%, while primary articles recorded inflation of...
Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Wholesale inflation surges to 12.29% in October,' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Wholesale inflation surges to 12.29% in Octob' should be permanently discontinued.
The author contends that 'Wholesale inflation surges to 12.29% in Octob' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: According to provisional government data, inflation in the fuel and power category climbed to 32.84%, while primary articles recorded inflation of...
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "According to provisional government data, inflation in the fuel and power category climbed to 32.84%, while primary articles recorded inflation of..." (Hinglish Arth: अनंतिम सरकारी आंकड़ों के अनुसार, ईंधन और बिजली श्रेणी में मुद्रास्फीति बढ़कर 32.84% हो गई, जबकि प्राथमिक वस्तुओं में मुद्रास्फीति 9.24% दर्ज की गई।)

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.badge: Analytical Q2 • Key Evidence, Policy & Way Forward
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Wholesale inflation surges to 12.29% in October, fuel and power prices lead rise"?
options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
economy, business and finance / inflation and deflation.
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: economy, business and finance / inflation and deflation.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "economy, business and finance / inflation and deflation." (Hinglish Arth: अर्थव्यवस्था, व्यापार और वित्त / मुद्रास्फीति और अपस्फीति)

hinglishTracks.en: According to provisional government data, inflation in the fuel and power category climbed to 32.84%, while primary articles recorded inflation of 9.24%.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — अनंतिम सरकारी आंकड़ों के अनुसार, ईंधन और बिजली श्रेणी में मुद्रास्फीति बढ़कर 32.84% हो गई, जबकि प्राथमिक वस्तुओं में मुद्रास्फीति 9.24% दर्ज की गई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inflation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महंगाई (मुद्रास्फीति) — जब बाज़ार में वस्तुओं के दाम बढ़ें और रुपये की खरीद शक्ति कम हो जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Price-escalation, Hyperinflation, Dearness और Antonyms हैं: Deflation, Disinflation, Recession।

hinglishTracks.en: Inflation in manufactured products, meanwhile, eased marginally to 9.54%
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इस बीच, विनिर्मित उत्पादों में मुद्रास्फीति मामूली कम होकर 9.54% पर आ गई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inflation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महंगाई (मुद्रास्फीति) — जब बाज़ार में वस्तुओं के दाम बढ़ें और रुपये की खरीद शक्ति कम हो जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Price-escalation, Hyperinflation, Dearness और Antonyms हैं: Deflation, Disinflation, Recession।

hinglishTracks.en: India’s wholesale price inflation accelerated to 12.29% in October 2026, compared with 11.39% in September, according to provisional data released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry on Monday.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — वाणिज्य और उद्योग मंत्रालय द्वारा सोमवार को जारी अनंतिम आंकड़ों के अनुसार, भारत की थोक मूल्य मुद्रास्फीति अक्टूबर 2026 में बढ़कर 12.29% हो गई, जो सितंबर में 11.39% थी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inflation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महंगाई (मुद्रास्फीति) — जब बाज़ार में वस्तुओं के दाम बढ़ें और रुपये की खरीद शक्ति कम हो जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Price-escalation, Hyperinflation, Dearness और Antonyms हैं: Deflation, Disinflation, Recession।

hinglishTracks.en: The All India Wholesale Price Index (WPI) for all commodities rose to 113.3 in October, from 112.5 in the previous month.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — सभी वस्तुओं के लिए अखिल भारतीय थोक मूल्य सूचकांक (डब्ल्यूपीआई) अक्टूबर में बढ़कर 113.3 हो गया, जो पिछले महीने में 112.5 था।।

hinglishTracks.en: Fuel and power prices remained the biggest driver of wholesale inflation, with the category recording an annual inflation rate of 32.84% in October, sharply higher than the 25.85% recorded in September.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — ईंधन और बिजली की कीमतें थोक मुद्रास्फीति का सबसे बड़ा चालक बनी रहीं, इस श्रेणी में अक्टूबर में वार्षिक मुद्रास्फीति दर 32.84% दर्ज की गई, जो सितंबर में दर्ज 25.85% से काफी अधिक है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inflation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महंगाई (मुद्रास्फीति) — जब बाज़ार में वस्तुओं के दाम बढ़ें और रुपये की खरीद शक्ति कम हो जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Price-escalation, Hyperinflation, Dearness और Antonyms हैं: Deflation, Disinflation, Recession।

hinglishTracks.en: Inflation in primary articles also increased to 9.24% from 8.67% during the same period.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — इसी अवधि में प्राथमिक वस्तुओं की मुद्रास्फीति भी 8.67% से बढ़कर 9.24% हो गई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inflation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महंगाई (मुद्रास्फीति) — जब बाज़ार में वस्तुओं के दाम बढ़ें और रुपये की खरीद शक्ति कम हो जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Price-escalation, Hyperinflation, Dearness और Antonyms हैं: Deflation, Disinflation, Recession।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इस बीच, विनिर्मित उत्पादों में मुद्रास्फीति मामूली कम होकर 9.54% हो गई, जो सितंबर में 9.76% थी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inflation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महंगाई (मुद्रास्फीति) — जब बाज़ार में वस्तुओं के दाम बढ़ें और रुपये की खरीद शक्ति कम हो जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Price-escalation, Hyperinflation, Dearness और Antonyms हैं: Deflation, Disinflation, Recession।

hinglishTracks.en: Within the fuel and power category, inflation in mineral oils rose to 45.57% in October from 40.02% in September.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — ईंधन और बिजली श्रेणी में, खनिज तेलों की मुद्रास्फीति सितंबर में 40.02% से बढ़कर अक्टूबर में 45.57% हो गई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inflation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महंगाई (मुद्रास्फीति) — जब बाज़ार में वस्तुओं के दाम बढ़ें और रुपये की खरीद शक्ति कम हो जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Price-escalation, Hyperinflation, Dearness और Antonyms हैं: Deflation, Disinflation, Recession।

hinglishTracks.en: Crude petroleum and natural gas recorded a sharp increase, with inflation climbing to 70.80% from 57.32%.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — कच्चे पेट्रोलियम और प्राकृतिक गैस में तेज वृद्धि दर्ज की गई, मुद्रास्फीति 57.32% से बढ़कर 70.80% हो गई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inflation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महंगाई (मुद्रास्फीति) — जब बाज़ार में वस्तुओं के दाम बढ़ें और रुपये की खरीद शक्ति कम हो जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Price-escalation, Hyperinflation, Dearness और Antonyms हैं: Deflation, Disinflation, Recession।

hinglishTracks.en: Electricity inflation also moved into positive territory at 8.06%, compared with -0.43% in the previous month.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — बिजली मुद्रास्फीति भी पिछले महीने के -0.43% की तुलना में 8.06% पर सकारात्मक क्षेत्र में पहुंच गई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inflation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महंगाई (मुद्रास्फीति) — जब बाज़ार में वस्तुओं के दाम बढ़ें और रुपये की खरीद शक्ति कम हो जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Price-escalation, Hyperinflation, Dearness और Antonyms हैं: Deflation, Disinflation, Recession।

hinglishTracks.en: The government’s data identified mineral oils, crude petroleum and natural gas, electricity, food articles, basic metals, chemicals, food products, non-food articles, textiles, and rubber and plastic products among the major contributors to wholesale price inflation during October.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — सरकार के आंकड़ों ने अक्टूबर के दौरान थोक मूल्य मुद्रास्फीति में प्रमुख योगदानकर्ताओं में खनिज तेल, कच्चे पेट्रोलियम और प्राकृतिक गैस, बिजली, खाद्य लेख, बुनियादी धातु, रसायन, खाद्य उत्पाद, गैर-खाद्य लेख, कपड़ा और रबर और प्लास्टिक उत्पादों की पहचान की।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inflation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महंगाई (मुद्रास्फीति) — जब बाज़ार में वस्तुओं के दाम बढ़ें और रुपये की खरीद शक्ति कम हो जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Price-escalation, Hyperinflation, Dearness और Antonyms हैं: Deflation, Disinflation, Recession।

hinglishTracks.en: The Wholesale Price Index’s food index, which accounts for 24.99% of the overall basket, recorded inflation of 8.58% in October, marginally lower than the 8.66% reported in September.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — थोक मूल्य सूचकांक के खाद्य सूचकांक, जो कुल टोकरी का 24.99% है, ने अक्टूबर में 8.58% की मुद्रास्फीति दर्ज की, जो सितंबर में रिपोर्ट की गई 8.66% से मामूली कम है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — हालाँकि, प्राथमिक वस्तुओं की श्रेणी के तहत खाद्य वस्तुओं की मुद्रास्फीति 8.14% से बढ़कर 8.26% हो गई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inflation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महंगाई (मुद्रास्फीति) — जब बाज़ार में वस्तुओं के दाम बढ़ें और रुपये की खरीद शक्ति कम हो जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Price-escalation, Hyperinflation, Dearness और Antonyms हैं: Deflation, Disinflation, Recession।

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #13 of 30 (16 NOV)

📰 Wholesale inflation surges to 12.29% in October, fuel and power prices lead rise

📌 Published: 16 Nov 2026, 12:50:06 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: According to provisional government data, inflation in the fuel and power category climbed to 32.84%, while primary articles recorded inflation of 9.24%. Inflation in manufactured products, meanwhile, eased marginally to 9.54%

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India’s wholesale price inflation accelerated to 12.29% in October 2026, compared with 11.39% in September, according to provisional data released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry on Monday. The All India Wholesale Price Index (WPI) for all commodities rose to 113.3 in October, from 112.5 in the previous month. Fuel and power prices remained the biggest driver of wholesale inflation, with the category recording an annual inflation rate of 32.84% in October, sharply higher than the 25.85% recorded in September. Inflation in primary articles also increased to 9.24% from 8.67% during the same period. Meanwhile, inflation in manufactured products eased marginally to 9.54%, compared with 9.76% in September. Within the fuel and power category, inflation in mineral oils rose to 45.57% in October from 40.02% in September. Crude petroleum and natural gas recorded a sharp increase, with inflation climbing to 70.80% from 57.32%. Electricity inflation also moved into positive territory at 8.06%, compared with -0.43% in the previous month. The government’s data identified mineral oils, crude petroleum and natural gas, electricity, food articles, basic metals, chemicals, food products, non-food articles, textiles, and rubber and plastic products among the major contributors to wholesale price inflation during October. The Wholesale Price Index’s food index, which accounts for 24.99% of the overall basket, recorded inflation of 8.58% in October, marginally lower than the 8.66% reported in September. Inflation in food articles under the primary articles category, however, rose to 8.26% from 8.14%. Among manufactured products, inflation in chemicals and chemical products increased to 17.53% in October from 16.74% in September. Basic metals inflation rose to 17.21% from 16.96%, while textiles recorded inflation of 13.67%, compared with 13.85% in the previous month. Inflation in rubber and plastic products also increased to 13.90% from 13.47%. The Ministry said the October WPI figures are provisional and have been compiled with a weighted response rate of 81.1%. The final WPI inflation rate for August 2026 remained unchanged at 9.92%, with the index at 110.8. The government is scheduled to release the provisional Wholesale Price Index, Output Producer Price Index and trial Input Producer Price Index for November 2026 on December 14.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: economy, business and finance / inflation and deflation

C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Wholesale inflation surges to 12.29% in Octob' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Wholesale inflation surges to 12.29% in Octob' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Wholesale inflation surges to 12.29% in October, fuel and power prices lead rise"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. economy, business and finance / inflation and deflation.

✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "economy, business and finance / inflation and deflation." (Hinglish Arth: अर्थव्यवस्था, व्यापार और वित्त / मुद्रास्फीति और अपस्फीति)

articles.title: Ex-Bangladesh PM Hasina says if death is the price to pay for returning home, she is ready to face it
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: She was sentenced to death in absentia last year after a Bangladeshi court convicted her of crimes against humanity over a deadly crackdown on protesters

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Ousted Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, sentenced to capital punishment after she was toppled in 2024, told AFP on Monday (November 16, 2026) she would return home in December despite “the threat of death”. Ms. Hasina fled to India in August 2024 after a student-led uprising ended her iron-fisted 15-year rule, and has remained in hiding ever since. She was sentenced to death in absentia last year after a Bangladeshi court convicted her of crimes against humanity over a deadly crackdown on protesters. “I am fully aware of the risks I face if I return,” she told AFP in an email interview. “But I have made my decision, and no threat of death will keep me away from my own country.” Her insistence on going back comes days after Bangladesh said she would face execution if she returned, adding that she has no further legal recourse after missing the deadline to appeal against her conviction. The 79-year-old has repeatedly rejected the legitimacy of the trial. Dhaka has sought her extradition from India, which says the request is under legal review. “For months, they have demanded my return. Yet now that I am taking practical steps to come home, they appear to be more interested in threatening me... than actually allowing it to happen,” she said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Frankly, I find these contradictory statements from the Bangladeshi authorities rather revealing.”

📰 Ex-Bangladesh PM Hasina says if death is the price to pay for returning home, she is ready to face it

🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: She was sentenced to death in absentia last year after a Bangladeshi court convicted her of crimes against humanity over a deadly crackdown on protesters

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Ousted Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, sentenced to capital punishment after she was toppled in 2024, told AFP on Monday (November 16, 2026) she would return home in December despite “the threat of death”. Ms. Hasina fled to India in August 2024 after a student-led uprising ended her iron-fisted 15-year rule, and has remained in hiding ever since. She was sentenced to death in absentia last year after a Bangladeshi court convicted her of crimes against humanity over a deadly crackdown on protesters. “I am fully aware of the risks I face if I return,” she told AFP in an email interview. “But I have made my decision, and no threat of death will keep me away from my own country.” Her insistence on going back comes days after Bangladesh said she would face execution if she returned, adding that she has no further legal recourse after missing the deadline to appeal against her conviction. The 79-year-old has repeatedly rejected the legitimacy of the trial. Dhaka has sought her extradition from India, which says the request is under legal review. “For months, they have demanded my return. Yet now that I am taking practical steps to come home, they appear to be more interested in threatening me... than actually allowing it to happen,” she said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Frankly, I find these contradictory statements from the Bangladeshi authorities rather revealing.”

articles.title: European Union nations to unveil Rwanda deal for migrant return hub
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The group, also comprising Austria, Greece and the Netherlands, has been gunning to open a so-called "return-hub" despite rights groups' concerns, after the EU cleared the way with a recent toughening of migration rules

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Five European Union countries including Germany and Denmark are set to announce Monday (November 16, 2026) a deal to establish a migrant deportation centre in Rwanda, the first such facility outside the bloc. The group, also comprising Austria, Greece and the Netherlands, has been gunning to open a so-called "return-hub" despite rights groups' concerns, after the EU cleared the way with a recent toughening of migration rules. The five have kept the location under wraps as they negotiated with potential hosts, but European diplomats and other people briefed on the talks have indicated Rwanda as the chosen country. The African Great Lakes nation had confirmed in August it had begun "preliminary discussions" with several European States. And it is sending a delegation to a migration conference in Vienna, where several sources said the agreement would be unveiled at a press conference on Monday (November 16, 2026). "We shall see next week in Vienna," Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker told reporters Friday (November 13, 2026), when asked about the matter. The announcement is to mark the culmination of an EU push to boost deportations launched in 2024, on the back of a souring of public opinion on migration. Migrant arrivals have steadily declined over the past three years, as the bloc struck deals to stem departures with a host of countries in Africa and West Asia. Explained | Why has densely populated Rwanda agreed to the U.K.’s plan to deport migrants?
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: International arbitrators reject $134 million claim by Rwanda against U.K. for scrapped migrant deal

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #20 of 30 (16 NOV)

📰 European Union nations to unveil Rwanda deal for migrant return hub

🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The group, also comprising Austria, Greece and the Netherlands, has been gunning to open a so-called "return-hub" despite rights groups' concerns, after the EU cleared the way with a recent toughening of migration rules

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Five European Union countries including Germany and Denmark are set to announce Monday (November 16, 2026) a deal to establish a migrant deportation centre in Rwanda, the first such facility outside the bloc. The group, also comprising Austria, Greece and the Netherlands, has been gunning to open a so-called "return-hub" despite rights groups' concerns, after the EU cleared the way with a recent toughening of migration rules. The five have kept the location under wraps as they negotiated with potential hosts, but European diplomats and other people briefed on the talks have indicated Rwanda as the chosen country. The African Great Lakes nation had confirmed in August it had begun "preliminary discussions" with several European States. And it is sending a delegation to a migration conference in Vienna, where several sources said the agreement would be unveiled at a press conference on Monday (November 16, 2026). "We shall see next week in Vienna," Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker told reporters Friday (November 13, 2026), when asked about the matter. The announcement is to mark the culmination of an EU push to boost deportations launched in 2024, on the back of a souring of public opinion on migration. Migrant arrivals have steadily declined over the past three years, as the bloc struck deals to stem departures with a host of countries in Africa and West Asia. Explained | Why has densely populated Rwanda agreed to the U.K.’s plan to deport migrants?

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: International arbitrators reject $134 million claim by Rwanda against U.K. for scrapped migrant deal

articles.title: In reversal, U.S. to fund UN military support in Somalia for another year
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The United States will renew support to international military operations in Somalia, the State Department told AFP on Sunday (November 15, 2026), reversing cuts that had threatened the survival of a coalition fighting Islamist insurgents in the country.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Washington had stopped funding the United Nations Support Office for Somalia (UNSOS) — which provides crucial logistics to African Union military operations — and had given it until the end of 2027 to shut down entirely. The Al-Qaeda-linked Al-Shabaab has been fighting the Somali government for two decades and continues to control large swathes of central Somalia despite the African Union military campaign, which was unlikely to be able to continue without UNSOS support. Washington had expressed frustration with the Somali government's lack of progress against Al-Shabaab and the persistent political chaos in the country as reasons for cutting the funding. But on Sunday (November 15, 2026), the U.S. State Department said that after consideration, the United States has decided to "support a one-year renewal of the mandates" for both UNSOS and the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM). A foreign diplomatic source working on Somalia told AFP the return of US support was welcome but that the sudden swings in policy were "madness". The source, who requested anonymity as they were not authorised to speak publicly on the matter, expressed shock that Washington did not use the promise of renewed funding to put pressure on the Somali government, which has lately descended into fresh in-fighting and political chaos that are undermining the campaign against the insurgents. Last week, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud fired the chief justice of the Supreme Court as it was about to rule against the extension of his term in office, which it said was illegal, and which has triggered violent clashes with Opposition parties and regional leaders. Mohamud has tried to move Somalia towards fully democratic elections, but sparked uproar when he pushed through constitutional changes in March that gave him an extra year in office.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The group claimed last month it had killed hundreds of elite Somali soldiers in an ambush in the Lower Shabelle region -- potentially one of its deadliest attacks in years, although the government has not released a death toll.

Last week, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud fired the chief justice of the Supreme Court as it was about to rule against the extension of his term in office, which it said was illegal, and which has triggered violent clashes with Opposition parties and regional leaders. Mohamud has tried to move Somalia towards fully democratic elections, but sparked uproar when he pushed through constitutional changes in March that gave him an extra year in office.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The group claimed last month it had killed hundreds of elite Somali soldiers in an ambush in the Lower Shabelle region -- potentially one of its deadliest attacks in years, although the government has not released a death toll.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The United States will renew support to international military operations in Somalia, the State Department told AFP on Sunday (November 15, 2026), reversing cuts that had threatened the survival of a coalition fighting Islamist insurgents in the country.
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Washington had stopped funding the United Nations Support Office for Somalia (UNSOS) — which provides crucial logistics to African Union military operations — and had given it until the end of 2027 to shut down entirely. The Al-Qaeda-linked Al-Shabaab has been fighting the Somali government for two decades and continues to control large swathes of central Somalia despite the African Union military campaign, which was unlikely to be able to continue without UNSOS support. Washington had expressed frustration with the Somali government's lack of progress against Al-Shabaab and the persistent political chaos in the country as reasons for cutting the funding. But on Sunday (November 15, 2026), the U.S. State Department said that after consideration, the United States has decided to "support a one-year renewal of the mandates" for both UNSOS and the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM). A foreign diplomatic source working on Somalia told AFP the return of US support was welcome but that the sudden swings in policy were "madness". The source, who requested anonymity as they were not authorised to speak publicly on the matter, expressed shock that Washington did not use the promise of renewed funding to put pressure on the Somali government, which has lately descended into fresh in-fighting and political chaos that are undermining the campaign against the insurgents. Last week, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud fired the chief justice of the Supreme Court as it was about to rule against the extension of his term in office, which it said was illegal, and which has triggered violent clashes with Opposition parties and regional leaders. Mohamud has tried to move Somalia towards fully democratic elections, but sparked uproar when he pushed through constitutional changes in March that gave him an extra year in office.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The group claimed last month it had killed hundreds of elite Somali soldiers in an ambush in the Lower Shabelle region -- potentially one of its deadliest attacks in years, although the government has not released a death toll.

articles.title: Prince and Princess of Wales in Mumbai for Earthshot Prize 2026: All you need to know

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The sixth Earthshot Prize, founded by Britain’s Prince William to promote innovative climate change solutions, will be presented in Mumbai on November 17, 2026

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Britain’s Prince William and Princess Catherine (Kate) has arrived in Mumbai for a three-day visit to India as part of the sixth edition of The Earthshot Prize. They will join 5,000 guests, including environmental innovators, business leaders, philanthropists and celebrities from across the world in Mumbai on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) to celebrate the prestigious environmental awards. This marks the royal couples’ first joint overseas engagement since Ms. Kate announced her cancer diagnosis in 2024, also her first Earthshot Prize since 2022, when the ceremony was held in Boston, United States. The couple’s return to India comes nearly a decade after their previous joint visit to the country in 2016, when they also travelled to Bhutan. The Earthshot Prize is a prestigious environmental award, a project that was launched by Prince William in 2020, and is supported by a global coalition of philanthropists and organisations. It aims to encourage innovative solutions to climate change and other major environmental challenges such as air pollution, waste, ocean conservation and the loss of biodiversity. It also aims to recognise 50 winners over a 10-year period. Every year, five winners are selected from 15 global finalists, with each winner receiving £1 million (approx. ₹12.5 crore) to encourage their work and turn bold environmental ideas into actual impact. In November 2026, the sixth edition of the award arrives in Mumbai, also the first time the ceremony is held in India. The Earthshot Awards operate on the belief that human ingenuity, innovation and optimism can help repair the planet. Each year, 15 climate solutions are shortlisted across five categories known as Earthshots: Protect and Restore Nature, Clean Our Air, Revive Our Ocean, Build a Waste Free World, and Fix Our Climate. Under the ‘Protect and Restore Nature’ category, Bhutan’s Princess Chimi Yangzom Wangchuck and Karma Tenzin, senior forestry officer, have been shortlisted for their work in protecting the Himalayan forests which help the water systems that sustain 1.6 billion people downstream across South Asia. Sam Murray, CEO of ‘The Indigenous Alliance’, has been shortlisted for supporting rangers caring for 270 million hectares of Australian desert. Dr Jodi Hilty, president and chief scientist, and Chief Harlan Schilling of the Yellowstone to Yukon Conservation Initiative have been shortlisted for reconnecting 3,400 km of wilderness across Canada and the United States.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Under the ‘Clean Our Air’ category, Suman Mishra, managing director and CEO of Mahindra Last Mile Mobility, has been shortlisted for building affordable electric rickshaws.

hinglishTracks.en: Under the ‘Protect and Restore Nature’ category, Bhutan’s Princess Chimi Yangzom Wangchuck and Karma Tenzin, senior forestry officer, have been shortlisted for their work in protecting the Himalayan forests which help the water systems that sustain 1.6 billion people downstream across South Asia.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — 'प्रकृति की रक्षा और पुनर्स्थापन' श्रेणी के तहत, भूटान की राजकुमारी चिमी यांगज़ोम वांगचुक और वरिष्ठ वानिकी अधिकारी कर्मा तेनज़िन को हिमालय के जंगलों की रक्षा में उनके काम के लिए चुना गया है, जो दक्षिण एशिया में 1.6 अरब लोगों को पानी देने वाली जल प्रणालियों में मदद करते हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Sustainability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास। इसके Synonyms हैं: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability और Antonyms हैं: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction।

hinglishTracks.en: Sam Murray, CEO of ‘The Indigenous Alliance’, has been shortlisted for supporting rangers caring for 270 million hectares of Australian desert.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — 'द इंडिजिनस अलायंस' के सीईओ सैम मरे को 270 मिलियन हेक्टेयर ऑस्ट्रेलियाई रेगिस्तान की देखभाल करने वाले रेंजरों का समर्थन करने के लिए चुना गया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Indigenous' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: स्वदेशी — अपने ही देश (भारत) के वैज्ञानिकों और इंजीनियरों द्वारा देश में विकसित किया गया। इसके Synonyms हैं: Domestic, Home-grown, Native और Antonyms हैं: Imported, Foreign, Exotic।

hinglishTracks.en: Dr Jodi Hilty, president and chief scientist, and Chief Harlan Schilling of the Yellowstone to Yukon Conservation Initiative have been shortlisted for reconnecting 3,400 km of wilderness across Canada and the United States.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — डॉ. जोडी हिल्टी, अध्यक्ष और मुख्य वैज्ञानिक, और येलोस्टोन टू युकोन कंजर्वेशन इनिशिएटिव के प्रमुख हरलान शिलिंग को कनाडा और संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में 3,400 किमी के जंगल को फिर से जोड़ने के लिए चुना गया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Conservation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Conservation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Under the ‘Clean Our Air’ category, Suman Mishra, managing director and CEO of Mahindra Last Mile Mobility, has been shortlisted for building affordable electric rickshaws.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #22 of 30 (16 NOV)

📰 Prince and Princess of Wales in Mumbai for Earthshot Prize 2026: All you need to know

📌 Published: 16 Nov 2026, 11:54:34 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The sixth Earthshot Prize, founded by Britain’s Prince William to promote innovative climate change solutions, will be presented in Mumbai on November 17, 2026

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Britain’s Prince William and Princess Catherine (Kate) has arrived in Mumbai for a three-day visit to India as part of the sixth edition of The Earthshot Prize. They will join 5,000 guests, including environmental innovators, business leaders, philanthropists and celebrities from across the world in Mumbai on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) to celebrate the prestigious environmental awards. This marks the royal couples’ first joint overseas engagement since Ms. Kate announced her cancer diagnosis in 2024, also her first Earthshot Prize since 2022, when the ceremony was held in Boston, United States. The couple’s return to India comes nearly a decade after their previous joint visit to the country in 2016, when they also travelled to Bhutan. The Earthshot Prize is a prestigious environmental award, a project that was launched by Prince William in 2020, and is supported by a global coalition of philanthropists and organisations. It aims to encourage innovative solutions to climate change and other major environmental challenges such as air pollution, waste, ocean conservation and the loss of biodiversity. It also aims to recognise 50 winners over a 10-year period. Every year, five winners are selected from 15 global finalists, with each winner receiving £1 million (approx. ₹12.5 crore) to encourage their work and turn bold environmental ideas into actual impact. In November 2026, the sixth edition of the award arrives in Mumbai, also the first time the ceremony is held in India. The Earthshot Awards operate on the belief that human ingenuity, innovation and optimism can help repair the planet. Each year, 15 climate solutions are shortlisted across five categories known as Earthshots: Protect and Restore Nature, Clean Our Air, Revive Our Ocean, Build a Waste Free World, and Fix Our Climate. Under the ‘Protect and Restore Nature’ category, Bhutan’s Princess Chimi Yangzom Wangchuck and Karma Tenzin, senior forestry officer, have been shortlisted for their work in protecting the Himalayan forests which help the water systems that sustain 1.6 billion people downstream across South Asia. Sam Murray, CEO of ‘The Indigenous Alliance’, has been shortlisted for supporting rangers caring for 270 million hectares of Australian desert. Dr Jodi Hilty, president and chief scientist, and Chief Harlan Schilling of the Yellowstone to Yukon Conservation Initiative have been shortlisted for reconnecting 3,400 km of wilderness across Canada and the United States.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Under the ‘Clean Our Air’ category, Suman Mishra, managing director and CEO of Mahindra Last Mile Mobility, has been shortlisted for building affordable electric rickshaws.

Environmental (Adjective)
पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural  |  ✖ Ant: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic
Indigenous (Adjective)
स्वदेशी — अपने ही देश (भारत) के वैज्ञानिकों और इंजीनियरों द्वारा देश में विकसित किया गया।
✓ Syn: Domestic, Home-grown, Native  |  ✖ Ant: Imported, Foreign, Exotic
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Conservation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Conservation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Italy’s data protection authority conducted a technical analysis after it received a complaint from a consumer protection forum, which said that the platform accessed “unpublished files stored on users’ smartphones”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story so far: Italy’s data protection authority fined Meta, Facebook's parent company, €805 million ($880 million) on Saturday (November 14, 2026) for accessing photos and videos from Android users' galleries without obtaining specific consent. This is the largest fine imposed by an Italian authority on a tech company. Facebook offers a feature that gives users suggestions for posts from the photos and videos available in their phone gallery as they scroll through the platform. The ‘get tips from your gallery while browsing Facebook’ feature has been available in the application since 2023.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Italy / social media / data protection / The Hindu Explains

articles.title: India, U.S., eight other nations sign declaration to safeguard AI supply chains
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Pax Silica initiative was announced by the U.S. in December last year to secure supply chains for silicon and other minerals essential to semiconductor production and, by extension, to AI

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India, the U.S. and eight other countries have signed a declaration to treat safeguarding Artificial Intelligence (AI) supply chains as a “shared endeavour” amid growing competition with China in emerging technology. The San Francisco Declaration was signed at a meeting of the founders of the U.S.-led Pax Silica initiative convened by U.S. Under Secretary of State for Economic Affairs Jacob Helberg on Sunday (November 15, 2026). The declaration was released by the Governments of the U.S., Australia, India, Israel, Japan, South Korea, Qatar, Singapore, the United Arab Emirates, and the United Kingdom. The Pax Silica initiative was announced by the U.S. in December last year to secure supply chains for silicon and other minerals essential to semiconductor production and, by extension, to artificial intelligence and other advanced technological industries. The declaration on Sunday (November 15) affirms that economic security is fundamental to national security, sets out the participants’ common understanding of the sensitive technologies and critical infrastructure that underpin Super Intelligence supply chains, and declares that safeguarding them is a shared endeavour, a State Department statement said. The U.S. government refers to Artificial Intelligence (AI) as Super Intelligence (SI) after President Donald Trump signed an executive order to rename it. The Declaration on Secure Foundations of Enduring Prosperity also resolves to establish working groups to carry common purpose into common practice. It proposed to set up five groups covering pro-innovation policy frameworks, SI adoption in key sectors, supply chain cooperation across the SI stack, safe harbours and supply chain security hubs, and SI security and resilience. “No nation can secure the foundations of the SI era alone, and the prosperity SI makes possible will only be as durable as the supply chains and infrastructure beneath it,” the statement said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The declaration said that by agreeing on what must be protected and committing to protect it together, participants are laying the secure foundations on which partner nations can innovate, invest, and grow.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #28 of 30 (16 NOV)

📰 India, U.S., eight other nations sign declaration to safeguard AI supply chains

📌 Published: 16 Nov 2026, 12:40:45 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Pax Silica initiative was announced by the U.S. in December last year to secure supply chains for silicon and other minerals essential to semiconductor production and, by extension, to AI

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India, the U.S. and eight other countries have signed a declaration to treat safeguarding Artificial Intelligence (AI) supply chains as a “shared endeavour” amid growing competition with China in emerging technology. The San Francisco Declaration was signed at a meeting of the founders of the U.S.-led Pax Silica initiative convened by U.S. Under Secretary of State for Economic Affairs Jacob Helberg on Sunday (November 15, 2026). The declaration was released by the Governments of the U.S., Australia, India, Israel, Japan, South Korea, Qatar, Singapore, the United Arab Emirates, and the United Kingdom. The Pax Silica initiative was announced by the U.S. in December last year to secure supply chains for silicon and other minerals essential to semiconductor production and, by extension, to artificial intelligence and other advanced technological industries. The declaration on Sunday (November 15) affirms that economic security is fundamental to national security, sets out the participants’ common understanding of the sensitive technologies and critical infrastructure that underpin Super Intelligence supply chains, and declares that safeguarding them is a shared endeavour, a State Department statement said. The U.S. government refers to Artificial Intelligence (AI) as Super Intelligence (SI) after President Donald Trump signed an executive order to rename it. The Declaration on Secure Foundations of Enduring Prosperity also resolves to establish working groups to carry common purpose into common practice. It proposed to set up five groups covering pro-innovation policy frameworks, SI adoption in key sectors, supply chain cooperation across the SI stack, safe harbours and supply chain security hubs, and SI security and resilience. “No nation can secure the foundations of the SI era alone, and the prosperity SI makes possible will only be as durable as the supply chains and infrastructure beneath it,” the statement said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The declaration said that by agreeing on what must be protected and committing to protect it together, participants are laying the secure foundations on which partner nations can innovate, invest, and grow.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Resilience (Noun)
लचीलापन और मज़बूती — किसी बड़े संकट या मंदी के बाद तेज़ी से वापस उभरने की क्षमता।
✓ Syn: Robustness, Endurance, Adaptability  |  ✖ Ant: Fragility, Vulnerability, Weakness
Technological (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Technological' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Intelligence (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Intelligence' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Declaration (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Declaration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "India, U.S., eight other nations sign declaration to safeguard AI supply chains", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The Pax Silica initiative was announced by the U.S.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'India, U.S., eight other nations sign declaratio' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'India, U.S., eight other nations sign declara' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'India, U.S., eight other nations sign declara' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The Pax Silica initiative was announced by the U.S." (Hinglish Arth: पैक्स सिलिका पहल की घोषणा अमेरिका द्वारा की गई थी।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "India, U.S., eight other nations sign declaration to safeguard AI supply chains"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The declaration said that by agreeing on what must be protected and committing to protect it together, participants are laying the secure foundations...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The declaration said that by agreeing on what must be protected and committing to protect it together, participants are laying the secure foundations..." (Hinglish Arth: घोषणा में कहा गया है कि जिस चीज की रक्षा की जानी चाहिए उस पर सहमति जताकर और साथ मिलकर उसकी रक्षा करने की प्रतिबद्धता जताकर, प्रतिभागी सुरक्षित नींव रख रहे हैं, जिस पर साझेदार देश नवप्रवर्तन, निवेश और विकास कर सकते हैं।)

hinglishTracks.en: Dhun Davar, deputy CEO & chief of programmes, AVPN spoke to The Hindu about the challenges in the TB elimination programme
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — एवीपीएन के डिप्टी सीईओ और कार्यक्रम प्रमुख धुन डावर ने टीबी उन्मूलन कार्यक्रम में चुनौतियों के बारे में द हिंदू से बात की।

hinglishTracks.en: India’s tuberculosis (TB) burden remains substantial despite progress.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — प्रगति के बावजूद भारत में तपेदिक (टीबी) का बोझ काफी बना हुआ है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The country has the largest TB burden in the world, accounting for approximately one-quarter of all TB cases globally.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — देश में दुनिया में टीबी का सबसे बड़ा बोझ है, जो वैश्विक स्तर पर सभी टीबी के लगभग एक-चौथाई मामलों के लिए जिम्मेदार है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

hinglishTracks.en: The number of new cases fell 21% between 2015 and 2024, while treatment coverage rose to 92%, according to World Health Organisation data cited by the government.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — सरकार द्वारा उद्धृत विश्व स्वास्थ्य संगठन के आंकड़ों के अनुसार, 2015 और 2024 के बीच नए मामलों की संख्या में 21% की गिरावट आई, जबकि उपचार कवरेज बढ़कर 92% हो गया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Organisation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Organisation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The Central government recently started the JOSH campaign -- launched in 11 States and 55 districts to promote screening, early diagnosis and treatment adherence.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — केंद्र सरकार ने हाल ही में स्क्रीनिंग, शीघ्र निदान और उपचार अनुपालन को बढ़ावा देने के लिए 11 राज्यों और 55 जिलों में जोश अभियान शुरू किया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: JOSH stands for Joint Squad for Health.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — जोश का मतलब स्वास्थ्य के लिए संयुक्त दस्ता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: It is a youth-led community mobilisation initiative to strengthen India’s campaign to eliminate TB.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — यह टीबी को खत्म करने के भारत के अभियान को मजबूत करने के लिए युवाओं के नेतृत्व वाली सामुदायिक गतिशीलता पहल है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Dhun Davar, deputy CEO & chief of programmes, AVPN, spoke to The Hindu about the challenges in the TB elimination programme.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — एवीपीएन के डिप्टी सीईओ और कार्यक्रम प्रमुख धुन डावर ने टीबी उन्मूलन कार्यक्रम में चुनौतियों के बारे में द हिंदू से बात की।।

hinglishTracks.en: AVPN is a pan-Asian network of social investors, philanthropists, foundations, corporations and other organisations that work to direct funding and expertise towards social and environmental challenges.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — एवीपीएन सामाजिक निवेशकों, परोपकारियों, फाउंडेशनों, निगमों और अन्य संगठनों का एक अखिल एशियाई नेटवर्क है जो सामाजिक और पर्यावरणीय चुनौतियों के लिए धन और विशेषज्ञता को निर्देशित करने के लिए काम करता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Environmental' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित। इसके Synonyms हैं: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural और Antonyms हैं: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic।

hinglishTracks.en: Its work includes health equity, gender equality, climate action and economic inclusion.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इसके कार्य में स्वास्थ्य समानता, लैंगिक समानता, जलवायु कार्रवाई और आर्थिक समावेशन शामिल हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inclusive' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: समावेशी — जिसमें समाज के हर वर्ग (खासकर गरीब और वंचित वर्ग) को बराबर शामिल किया जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Egalitarian, All-encompassing और Antonyms हैं: Exclusive, Discriminatory, Narrow।

1. Core Context & Background: Dhun Davar, deputy CEO & chief of programmes, AVPN spoke to The Hindu about the challenges in the TB elimination programme

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India’s tuberculosis (TB) burden remains substantial despite progress. The country has the largest TB burden in the world, accounting for approximately one-quarter of all TB cases globally. The number of new cases fell 21% between 2015 and 2024, while treatment coverage rose to 92%, according to World Health Organisation data cited by the government. The Central government recently started the JOSH campaign -- launched in 11 States and 55 districts to promote screening, early diagnosis and treatment adherence. JOSH stands for Joint Squad for Health. It is a youth-led community mobilisation initiative to strengthen India’s campaign to eliminate TB.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Dhun Davar, deputy CEO & chief of programmes, AVPN, spoke to The Hindu about the challenges in the TB elimination programme. AVPN is a pan-Asian network of social investors, philanthropists, foundations, corporations and other organisations that work to direct funding and expertise towards social and environmental challenges. Its work includes health equity, gender equality, climate action and economic inclusion.

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

articles.title: Prince William, Princess Catherine play gully cricket with Sachin Tendulkar in Mumbai
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Details of the event were so closely guarded that the students taking part did not know who the visiting dignitaries were

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Prince William and Catherine, Princess of Wales, played gully cricket alongside cricket legend Sachin Tendulkar and schoolgirls from various foundations at Ballard Estate in south Mumbai on Monday (November 16, 2026), marking the beginning of their visit to the city ahead of the sixth annual Earthshot Prize Awards. The royal couple arrived at Ballard Estate, near Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT), accompanied by Mr. Tendulkar. Before joining the cricket session, they were served traditional Indian chai in kulhads, or earthen cups, by local tea vendors. William and Catherine then joined the schoolgirls for a game of gully cricket, taking turns batting and bowling alongside Mr. Tendulkar. The atmosphere turned lively as several girls chanted “Sachin, Sachin” while watching the cricket legend play. Prince William, Princess Catherine of Wales along with Sachin Tendulkar play Gully cricket with youth at Ballard Estate in Mumbai on Monday, November 16, 2026. The couple arrived in ​Mumbai to attend the annual ‌Earthshot Prize awards, marking the ​Princess of Wales' most high-profile ⁠overseas visit since undergoing treatment for cancer in 2024. Video: @EmmanualYogini The royal couple also interacted with the schoolgirls, who had come from various organisations, including the Sachin Tendulkar Foundation. They met members of a band performing at the venue, spoke to the tea vendors and signed autographs for the children. Among those who participated was Sakshi, a girl associated with the Sachin Tendulkar Foundation, who expressed her excitement at meeting the royal couple and Mr. Tendulkar. “I really enjoyed it. Sachin sir was there, and it was a lot of fun playing with the Prince and Princess,” she said. Another participant, Siddhi, who has been playing cricket for nearly a year, said Tendulkar had inspired her through his cricketing skills.“Sachin sir has inspired us many times with his skills,” she said, adding that she had an opportunity to speak to him during the event. “Sachin sir has inspired us many times with his skills,” she said, adding that she had an opportunity to speak to him during the event.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “He told me that I played well. We didn’t get much time to talk, but I also got his autograph,” Siddhi said.

The royal couple arrived at Ballard Estate, near Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT), accompanied by Mr. Tendulkar. Before joining the cricket session, they were served traditional Indian chai in kulhads, or earthen cups, by local tea vendors. William and Catherine then joined the schoolgirls for a game of gully cricket, taking turns batting and bowling alongside Mr. Tendulkar. The couple arrived in ​Mumbai to attend the annual ‌Earthshot Prize awards, marking the ​Princess of Wales' most high-profile ⁠overseas visit since undergoing treatment for cancer in 2024. Video: @EmmanualYogini The royal couple also interacted with the schoolgirls, who had come from various organisations, including the Sachin Tendulkar Foundation. They met members of a band performing at the venue, spoke to the tea vendors and signed autographs for the children. Among those who participated was Sakshi, a girl associated with the Sachin Tendulkar Foundation, who expressed her excitement at meeting the royal couple and Mr. Tendulkar. “I really enjoyed it. Sachin sir was there, and it was a lot of fun playing with the Prince and Princess,” she said. articles.title: Bilkis Bano case: Supreme Court suspends sentence, grants bail to two convicts
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: "Having heard the parties, it suffices to state that the appellants have been incarcerated for a period of more than 17 years, and also the fact remains that one of the appellants has a severe handicap. Certainly, there are issues to be decided in the appeal, both on fact and law," says Supreme Court

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court has suspended the life sentences of two convicts in the case of the gangrape of Bilkis Bano and the murder of seven of her family members during the 2002 riots in Gujarat and granted them bail. A Bench of Justices MM Sundresh and P.B. Varale noted that Bipin Chandra Joshi and Pradeep Mordhiya had been incarcerated for more than 17 years. "Having heard the parties, it suffices to state that the appellants have been incarcerated for a period of more than 17 years, and also the fact remains that one of the appellants has a severe handicap. Certainly, there are issues to be decided in the appeal, both on fact and law," the apex court said in its October 28 order, which has now been uploaded. "In view of the above and considering the issues involved in this appeal, we suspend the sentence and grant bail to the appellants on such terms and conditions as may be imposed by the concerned trial court," the bench added. Arguing that the two men have been incarcerated for more than 17 years, senior advocate Siddharth Luthra submitted that one of the convicts had not been named in the FIR and was implicated after nearly three years following the 2002 riots. Additional Solicitor General Raja Thakre vehemently opposed the plea and said the High Court and the trial court have taken into consideration the relevant material brought on record, especially as the offence committed is so serious. Bilkis Bano was 21 years old and five months pregnant when she was gang-raped while trying to escape the horror of the communal riots that broke out after the Godhra train burning incident in February 2002. Her three-year-old daughter was among the seven family members killed. The two convicts, Mordhiya and Joshi, are among the 11 whose remission was quashed by the Supreme Court in 2024. The other convicts in the case are Govind Nai, Ramesh Chandana, Mitesh Bhatt, Bakabhai Vohania, Kesarbhai Vohania, Jaswant Nai, Radheshyam Shah, Rajubhai Soni and Shailesh Bhatt.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Joshi and Mordhiya were convicted by the trial court under Sections 143 (unlawful assembly), 147 (rioting), 302 (murder) read with Sections 376 (rape) of the Indian Penal Code and were sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for life with fine.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (16 NOV)

📰 Bilkis Bano case: Supreme Court suspends sentence, grants bail to two convicts

📌 Published: 16 Nov 2026, 03:12:29 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: "Having heard the parties, it suffices to state that the appellants have been incarcerated for a period of more than 17 years, and also the fact remains that one of the appellants has a severe handicap. Certainly, there are issues to be decided in the appeal, both on fact and law," says Supreme Court

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court has suspended the life sentences of two convicts in the case of the gangrape of Bilkis Bano and the murder of seven of her family members during the 2002 riots in Gujarat and granted them bail. A Bench of Justices MM Sundresh and P.B. Varale noted that Bipin Chandra Joshi and Pradeep Mordhiya had been incarcerated for more than 17 years. "Having heard the parties, it suffices to state that the appellants have been incarcerated for a period of more than 17 years, and also the fact remains that one of the appellants has a severe handicap. Certainly, there are issues to be decided in the appeal, both on fact and law," the apex court said in its October 28 order, which has now been uploaded. "In view of the above and considering the issues involved in this appeal, we suspend the sentence and grant bail to the appellants on such terms and conditions as may be imposed by the concerned trial court," the bench added. Arguing that the two men have been incarcerated for more than 17 years, senior advocate Siddharth Luthra submitted that one of the convicts had not been named in the FIR and was implicated after nearly three years following the 2002 riots. Additional Solicitor General Raja Thakre vehemently opposed the plea and said the High Court and the trial court have taken into consideration the relevant material brought on record, especially as the offence committed is so serious. Bilkis Bano was 21 years old and five months pregnant when she was gang-raped while trying to escape the horror of the communal riots that broke out after the Godhra train burning incident in February 2002. Her three-year-old daughter was among the seven family members killed. The two convicts, Mordhiya and Joshi, are among the 11 whose remission was quashed by the Supreme Court in 2024. The other convicts in the case are Govind Nai, Ramesh Chandana, Mitesh Bhatt, Bakabhai Vohania, Kesarbhai Vohania, Jaswant Nai, Radheshyam Shah, Rajubhai Soni and Shailesh Bhatt.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Joshi and Mordhiya were convicted by the trial court under Sections 143 (unlawful assembly), 147 (rioting), 302 (murder) read with Sections 376 (rape) of the Indian Penal Code and were sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for life with fine.
